entries.title: insurance-zit-dglm
entries.summary: 零膨胀 Tweedie 双 GLM（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：三头 CatBoost 联合建模均值/离散/零膨胀
entries.summary_en: Zero-inflated Tweedie double GLM (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): three-head CatBoost for mean/dispersion/zero-inflation
entries.summary_hk: 零膨脹 Tweedie 雙 GLM（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：三頭 CatBoost 聯合建模均值/離散/零膨脹
entries.body: insurance-zit-dglm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做零膨胀 Tweedie 双 GLM：三头 CatBoost 联合建模均值、离散参数、零膨胀概率——保险损失数据的三个维度一次建模。对 RIAA：零膨胀（大量零索赔）是保险数据的核心特征——[[insurance-dispersion]]（双 GLM 均值-离散）的零膨胀扩展；三头架构展示现代 GBM 的分布建模能力；与 [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]]（NN 路线）、[[insurance-distributional]]（分布 GBM）配套；适合车险/家财险的损失建模。
entries.body_en: insurance-zit-dglm (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does zero-inflated Tweedie double GLM: three-head CatBoost jointly modelling mean, dispersion and zero-inflation probability — modelling three dimensions of insurance loss data at once. For RIAA: zero-inflation (many zero claims) is a defining feature of insurance data — the zero-inflated extension of [[insurance-dispersion]] (double GLM mean-dispersion); the three-head architecture shows modern GBM distributional power; pairs with [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]] (NN route) and [[insurance-distributional]] (distributional GBM); suits motor/home loss modelling.
entries.body_hk: insurance-zit-dglm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做零膨脹 Tweedie 雙 GLM：三頭 CatBoost 聯合建模均值、離散參數、零膨脹概率——保險損失數據的三個維度一次建模。對 RIAA：零膨脹（大量零索賠）是保險數據的核心特徵——[[insurance-dispersion]]（雙 GLM 均值-離散）的零膨脹擴展；三頭架構展示現代 GBM 的分佈建模能力；與 [[insurance-poisson-mixture-nn]]（NN 路線）、[[insurance-distributional]]（分佈 GBM）配套；適合車險/家財險的損失建模。

entries.title: insurance-poisson-mixture-nn
entries.summary: 神经泊松混合（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：结构零与随机零索赔者分离，UK 定价
entries.summary_en: Neural Poisson mixture (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): separating structural vs stochastic zero-claimers, UK pricing
entries.summary_hk: 神經泊松混合（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：結構零與隨機零索賠者分離，UK 定價
entries.body: insurance-poisson-mixture-nn（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用神经泊松混合模型分离结构零（从不索赔）与随机零（今年碰巧没索赔）索赔者——英国定价。对 RIAA：结构零 vs 偶发零的区分提升频率建模——[[insurance-cure]]（cure 模型生存路线）的 NN 版本；混合模型是「个体异质性」的显式建模（frailty 的另一种形式）；与 [[insurance-distributional]]（分布 GBM）配套；适合车险频率建模进阶与研究。
entries.body_en: insurance-poisson-mixture-nn (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses neural Poisson mixture models to separate structural zeros (never claim) from stochastic zeros (no claim this year) — UK pricing. For RIAA: distinguishing structural vs occasional zeros improves frequency modelling — the NN version of [[insurance-cure]] (cure-model survival route); mixture models explicitly model individual heterogeneity (another form of frailty); pairs with [[insurance-distributional]] (distributional GBM); suits advanced motor frequency modelling and research.
entries.body_hk: insurance-poisson-mixture-nn（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用神經泊松混合模型分離結構零（從不索賠）與隨機零（今年碰巧沒索賠）索賠者——英國定價。對 RIAA：結構零 vs 偶發零的區分提升頻率建模——[[insurance-cure]]（cure 模型生存路線）的 NN 版本；混合模型是「個體異質性」的顯式建模（frailty 的另一種形式）；與 [[insurance-distributional]]（分佈 GBM）配套；適合車險頻率建模進階與研究。

entries.title: insurance-dependent-fs
entries.summary: 依赖频率-严重度神经网络（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：两部件模型共享潜在因子
entries.summary_en: Dependent frequency-severity NN (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): two-part model with shared latent factors
entries.summary_hk: 依賴頻率-嚴重度神經網絡（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：兩部件模型共享潛在因子
entries.body: insurance-dependent-fs（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做依赖的频率-严重度神经网络：两部件模型（频率 + 严重度）共享潜在因子——频率与严重度相关的显式建模。对 RIAA：频率-严重度独立性假设在现实中常不成立（高风险司机频率和严重度都高）——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula）是统计路线、本包是 NN 路线（共享表征学习依赖）；两部件模型是精算定价的标准结构；适合车险综合建模与研究。
entries.body_en: insurance-dependent-fs (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does dependent frequency-severity neural networks: a two-part model (frequency + severity) with shared latent factors — explicitly modelling the dependence between frequency and severity. For RIAA: the independence assumption between frequency and severity often fails in practice (high-risk drivers have both higher frequency and severity) — [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (Sarmanov copula) is the statistical route, this package is the NN route (shared representation learning); two-part models are the standard pricing structure; suits integrated motor modelling and research.
entries.body_hk: insurance-dependent-fs（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做依賴的頻率-嚴重度神經網絡：兩部件模型（頻率 + 嚴重度）共享潛在因子——頻率與嚴重度相關的顯式建模。對 RIAA：頻率-嚴重度獨立性假設在現實中常不成立（高風險司機頻率和嚴重度都高）——[[insurance-frequency-severity]]（Sarmanov copula）是統計路線、本包是 NN 路線（共享表徵學習依賴）；兩部件模型是精算定價的標準結構；適合車險綜合建模與研究。

entries.title: insurance-glm-tools
entries.summary: GLM 工具集（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：嵌套 GLM + 实体嵌入、领土聚类、自动交互
entries.summary_en: GLM tooling (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.0): nested GLMs with entity embeddings, territory clustering, automated interactions
entries.summary_hk: GLM 工具集（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：嵌套 GLM + 實體嵌入、領土聚類、自動交互
entries.body: insurance-glm-tools（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）是 UK 定价的 GLM 工具集：嵌套 GLM + 实体嵌入（NN 学嵌入、GLM 用嵌入）、领土聚类、自动交互检测——[[insurance-glm-tools]] 的继任者（已废弃并入本包）。对 RIAA：GLM 仍是行业主流——本包把现代技术（嵌入/聚类/自动交互）融入 GLM 工作流；[[insurance-nested-glm]]（嵌套 GLM 专项）同主题；与 [[easy-glm]]（LASSO GLM 自动化）互补；适合从业者向的定价建模（与 [[insurance-deploy]] 配套）。
entries.body_en: insurance-glm-tools (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.0) is the GLM tooling for UK pricing: nested GLMs with entity embeddings (NN learns embeddings, GLM uses them), territory clustering, automated interaction detection — successor of [[insurance-glm-tools]] (deprecated into this package). For RIAA: GLMs remain the industry mainstream — this package integrates modern techniques (embeddings/clustering/automated interactions) into the GLM workflow; [[insurance-nested-glm]] covers the same nested-GLM theme; complements [[easy-glm]] (LASSO GLM automation); suits practitioner-oriented pricing modelling (pairs with [[insurance-deploy]]).
entries.body_hk: insurance-glm-tools（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）是 UK 定價的 GLM 工具集：嵌套 GLM + 實體嵌入（NN 學嵌入、GLM 用嵌入）、領土聚類、自動交互檢測——[[insurance-glm-tools]] 的繼任者（已廢棄併入本包）。對 RIAA：GLM 仍是行業主流——本包把現代技術（嵌入/聚類/自動交互）融入 GLM 工作流；[[insurance-nested-glm]]（嵌套 GLM 專項）同主題；與 [[easy-glm]]（LASSO GLM 自動化）互補；適合從業者向的定價建模（與 [[insurance-deploy]] 配套）。

entries.summary: 嵌套 GLM + 实体嵌入（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：NN 嵌入 + 空间约束领土聚类
entries.summary_en: Nested GLM with embeddings (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): NN entity embeddings + spatially constrained territory clustering
entries.summary_hk: 嵌套 GLM + 實體嵌入（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：NN 嵌入 + 空間約束領土聚類
entries.body: insurance-nested-glm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做嵌套 GLM：神经网络实体嵌入（高基数因子学嵌入向量）+ 空间约束领土聚类——GLM 的嵌入增强。对 RIAA：实体嵌入是「高基数分类因子」的现代解法（[[insurance-multilevel]] 随机效应的 NN 替代）——与 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-spatial]] 配套；「嵌入 + GLM」保持可解释性的同时获得 NN 的表征能力；嵌套结构（嵌入层在 GLM 内部）是精算 ML 的标志性架构；适合定价建模进阶。
entries.body_en: insurance-nested-glm (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does nested GLMs: neural entity embeddings (high-cardinality factors learn embedding vectors) + spatially constrained territory clustering — embedding-enhanced GLMs. For RIAA: entity embeddings are the modern solution for high-cardinality categorical factors (the NN alternative to [[insurance-multilevel]] random effects) — pairs with [[insurance-glm-tools]] and [[insurance-spatial]]; 'embeddings + GLM' keeps interpretability while gaining NN representation power; the nested structure (embedding layer inside GLM) is a signature actuarial ML architecture; suits advanced pricing modelling.
entries.body_hk: insurance-nested-glm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做嵌套 GLM：神經網絡實體嵌入（高基數因子學嵌入向量）+ 空間約束領土聚類——GLM 的嵌入增強。對 RIAA：實體嵌入是「高基數分類因子」的現代解法（[[insurance-multilevel]] 隨機效應的 NN 替代）——與 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-spatial]] 配套；「嵌入 + GLM」保持可解釋性的同時獲得 NN 的表徵能力；嵌套結構（嵌入層在 GLM 內部）是精算 ML 的標誌性架構；適合定價建模進階。

entries.title: insurance-pin
entries.summary: Pairwise Interaction Networks（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：神经 GA2M、共享权重架构
entries.summary_en: Pairwise Interaction Networks (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): neural GA2M, shared-weight architecture
entries.summary_hk: Pairwise Interaction Networks（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：神經 GA2M、共享權重架構
entries.body: insurance-pin（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）实现树状 Pairwise Interaction Networks（PIN）：神经 GA2M（广义加性二阶模型）——主效应 + 二阶交互的可解释 NN（共享权重架构）。对 RIAA：交互项是定价建模的常态（年龄×地区、车型×使用）——[[insurance-gam]]（GAM/EBM）处理加性、PIN 处理成对交互；GA2M 是可解释 ML 的经典方向（interpretML 家族）；与 [[insurance-interactions]]（GLM 交互检测）配套；适合可解释性与交互建模的交汇点。
entries.body_en: insurance-pin (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) implements tree-like Pairwise Interaction Networks (PIN): neural GA2M (generalised additive models with second-order interactions) — interpretable NNs with main effects + pairwise interactions (shared-weight architecture). For RIAA: interactions are the norm in pricing (age×territory, vehicle×usage) — [[insurance-gam]] (GAM/EBM) handles additivity, PIN handles pairwise interactions; GA2M is a classic explainable-ML direction (interpretML family); pairs with [[insurance-interactions]] (GLM interaction detection); suits the intersection of interpretability and interaction modelling.
entries.body_hk: insurance-pin（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）實現樹狀 Pairwise Interaction Networks（PIN）：神經 GA2M（廣義加性二階模型）——主效應 + 二階交互的可解釋 NN（共享權重架構）。對 RIAA：交互項是定價建模的常態（年齡×地區、車型×使用）——[[insurance-gam]]（GAM/EBM）處理加性、PIN 處理成對交互；GA2M 是可解釋 ML 的經典方向（interpretML 家族）；與 [[insurance-interactions]]（GLM 交互檢測）配套；適合可解釋性與交互建模的交匯點。

entries.summary: 空间聚类 Mixture of Experts（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：联合频率-严重度空间 MoE
entries.summary_en: Spatially clustered MoE (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): joint frequency-severity spatial mixture of experts
entries.summary_hk: 空間聚類 Mixture of Experts（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：聯合頻率-嚴重度空間 MoE
entries.body: insurance-scmoe（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空间聚类 Mixture of Experts（MoE）：联合频率-严重度的空间专家混合——不同地区由不同「专家」模型处理（空间分治）。对 RIAA：MoE 是「一个模型打天下」的替代——地区异质性大时分区建模（[[insurance-spatial]] 平滑 vs MoE 分治是两条路线）；与 [[insurance-frequency-severity]]（联合建模）、[[insurance-distributional]]（分布 GBM）配套；适合地域异质性强的车险/家财险；MoE 是 ML 的前沿架构（大模型中的稀疏激活）。
entries.body_en: insurance-scmoe (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does spatially clustered Mixture of Experts (MoE): spatial experts for joint frequency-severity — different regions handled by different 'expert' models (spatial divide-and-conquer). For RIAA: MoE is an alternative to 'one model fits all' — regional heterogeneity suggests regional models ([[insurance-spatial]] smoothing vs MoE partitioning are two routes); pairs with [[insurance-frequency-severity]] (joint modelling) and [[insurance-distributional]] (distributional GBM); suits motor/home with strong regional heterogeneity; MoE is a frontier ML architecture (sparse activation in LLMs).
entries.body_hk: insurance-scmoe（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空間聚類 Mixture of Experts（MoE）：聯合頻率-嚴重度的空間專家混合——不同地區由不同「專家」模型處理（空間分治）。對 RIAA：MoE 是「一個模型打天下」的替代——地區異質性大時分區建模（[[insurance-spatial]] 平滑 vs MoE 分治是兩條路線）；與 [[insurance-frequency-severity]]（聯合建模）、[[insurance-distributional]]（分佈 GBM）配套；適合地域異質性強的車險/家財險；MoE 是 ML 的前沿架構（大模型中的稀疏激活）。

entries.title: insurance-jlm
entries.summary: 联合纵向-生存模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：共享随机效应连接 telematics 轨迹与索赔风险
entries.summary_en: Joint longitudinal-survival (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): shared random effects linking telematics trajectories to claim risk
entries.summary_hk: 聯合縱向-生存模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：共享隨機效應連接 telematics 軌跡與索賠風險
entries.body: insurance-jlm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做联合纵向-生存模型（JLM）：共享随机效应把 telematics 驾驶轨迹（纵向数据）与索赔风险（生存事件）联合建模。对 RIAA：telematics（驾驶行为数据）的价值在于动态风险——[[insurance-telematics]]（HMM 风险评分）管评分、JLM 管纵向-事件联合；「驾驶行为变化如何预测未来索赔」是 JLM 回答的问题；生物统计方法（Wulfsohn-Tsiatis）在保险数据的移植；适合 telematics 与车险研究方向。
entries.body_en: insurance-jlm (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does joint longitudinal-survival models (JLM): shared random effects linking telematics driving trajectories (longitudinal) to claim risk (survival events). For RIAA: the value of telematics (driving behaviour data) is dynamic risk — [[insurance-telematics]] (HMM risk scoring) scores risk, JLM models the longitudinal-event joint; 'how do driving-behaviour changes predict future claims' is what JLM answers; a biostatistics method (Wulfsohn-Tsiatis) ported to insurance data; suits telematics and motor research.
entries.body_hk: insurance-jlm（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做聯合縱向-生存模型（JLM）：共享隨機效應把 telematics 駕駛軌跡（縱向數據）與索賠風險（生存事件）聯合建模。對 RIAA：telematics（駕駛行為數據）的價值在於動態風險——[[insurance-telematics]]（HMM 風險評分）管評分、JLM 管縱向-事件聯合；「駕駛行為變化如何預測未來索賠」是 JLM 回答的問題；生物統計方法（Wulfsohn-Tsiatis）在保險數據的移植；適合 telematics 與車險研究方向。

entries.summary_hk: 自動去偏 ML（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：Riesz representer 連續處理因果推斷
entries.body: insurance-autodml（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做自动去偏 ML（Auto-DML）：Riesz representer 估计连续处理变量的因果效应——UK 个人险场景（如费率变化对续保的连续因果效应）。对 RIAA：[[insurance-causal]]（因果定价）家族的进阶方法——连续处理（而非二元）的因果推断更难（倾向得分推广）；Riesz representer 是去偏 ML 的前沿（Chernozhukov 学派）；与 [[insurance-tmle]]（TMLE）、[[insurance-bcf]]（贝叶斯因果森林）配套；适合因果推断方向的研究型学生。
entries.body_en: insurance-autodml (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does automatic debiased ML (Auto-DML): Riesz-representer estimation of causal effects for continuous treatments — UK personal lines scenarios (e.g. continuous causal effect of rate changes on retention). For RIAA: an advanced member of the [[insurance-causal]] (causal pricing) family — causal inference with continuous (not binary) treatments is harder (generalised propensity scores); Riesz representers are the frontier of debiased ML (Chernozhukov school); pairs with [[insurance-tmle]] (TMLE) and [[insurance-bcf]] (Bayesian causal forests); suits research-oriented students in causal inference.
entries.body_hk: insurance-autodml（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做自動去偏 ML（Auto-DML）：Riesz representer 估計連續處理變量的因果效應——UK 個人險場景（如費率變化對續保的連續因果效應）。對 RIAA：[[insurance-causal]]（因果定價）家族的進階方法——連續處理（而非二元）的因果推斷更難（傾向得分推廣）；Riesz representer 是去偏 ML 的前沿（Chernozhukov 學派）；與 [[insurance-tmle]]（TMLE）、[[insurance-bcf]]（貝葉斯因果森林）配套；適合因果推斷方向的研究型學生。

entries.summary_en: Bayesian Causal Forests (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): stochtree BCF wrapper, heterogeneous treatment effects + FCA audit reports
entries.summary_hk: 貝葉斯因果森林（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：stochtree BCF 包裝、異質處理效應 + FCA 審計報告
entries.body: insurance-bcf（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）是 Bayesian Causal Forests（BCF）的 stochtree 包装：异质处理效应（HTE）估计 + FCA 审计报告生成——保险定价场景的因果森林。对 RIAA：BCF 是因果推断的黄金标准之一（Hahn et al. 2020）——处理效应异质性的贝叶斯建模；[[insurance-causal]]（因果定价）家族成员；「FCA 审计报告」输出贴合英国监管（Consumer Duty 公平性证据，[[insurance-fairness]] 相关）；与 [[insurance-uplift]]（留存 HTE）、[[insurance-autodml]] 配套。
entries.body_en: insurance-bcf (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) is a stochtree wrapper for Bayesian Causal Forests (BCF): heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) estimation + FCA audit report generation — causal forests for insurance pricing. For RIAA: BCF is a gold standard in causal inference (Hahn et al. 2020) — Bayesian modelling of treatment-effect heterogeneity; member of the [[insurance-causal]] family; the 'FCA audit report' output fits UK regulation (Consumer Duty fairness evidence, relevant to [[insurance-fairness]]); pairs with [[insurance-uplift]] (retention HTE) and [[insurance-autodml]].
entries.body_hk: insurance-bcf（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）是 Bayesian Causal Forests（BCF）的 stochtree 包裝：異質處理效應（HTE）估計 + FCA 審計報告生成——保險定價場景的因果森林。對 RIAA：BCF 是因果推斷的黃金標準之一（Hahn et al. 2020）——處理效應異質性的貝葉斯建模；[[insurance-causal]]（因果定價）家族成員；「FCA 審計報告」輸出貼合英國監管（Consumer Duty 公平性證據，[[insurance-fairness]] 相關）；與 [[insurance-uplift]]（留存 HTE）、[[insurance-autodml]] 配套。

entries.title: insurance-mediation
entries.summary: 因果中介分析（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：CDE/NDE 分解 postcode 效应，FCA 代理歧视审计
entries.summary_en: Causal mediation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): CDE/NDE decomposition of postcode effects, FCA proxy discrimination audits
entries.summary_hk: 因果中介分析（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：CDE/NDE 分解 postcode 效應，FCA 代理歧視審計
entries.body: insurance-mediation（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做因果中介分析：把 postcode 等因子的效应分解为合法部分（CDE 受控直接效应）与可疑部分（NDE 自然直接效应）——FCA 代理歧视审计。对 RIAA：歧视审计的核心问题——「postcode 的定价效应多少来自合法的地区风险、多少是种族/收入代理？」（[[insurance-fairness]] 的核心议题）；中介分析给出结构化答案；英国 FCA Consumer Duty 要求公平性证据（[[insurance-governance]] 配套）；与 [[insurance-fairness-ot]]、[[insurance-fairness-diag]] 构成公平性工具箱。
entries.body_en: insurance-mediation (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does causal mediation analysis: decomposing the effect of factors like postcode into legitimate parts (CDE controlled direct effects) and suspect parts (NDE natural direct effects) — FCA proxy discrimination audits. For RIAA: the core question of discrimination audits — 'how much of postcode's pricing effect is legitimate territorial risk vs proxy for race/income?' (the central [[insurance-fairness]] issue); mediation analysis gives a structured answer; UK FCA Consumer Duty demands fairness evidence (pairs with [[insurance-governance]]); with [[insurance-fairness-ot]] and [[insurance-fairness-diag]] it forms the fairness toolbox.
entries.body_hk: insurance-mediation（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做因果中介分析：把 postcode 等因子的效應分解為合法部分（CDE 受控直接效應）與可疑部分（NDE 自然直接效應）——FCA 代理歧視審計。對 RIAA：歧視審計的核心問題——「postcode 的定價效應多少來自合法的地區風險、多少是種族/收入代理？」（[[insurance-fairness]] 的核心議題）；中介分析給出結構化答案；英國 FCA Consumer Duty 要求公平性證據（[[insurance-governance]] 配套）；與 [[insurance-fairness-ot]]、[[insurance-fairness-diag]] 構成公平性工具箱。

entries.title: insurance-fairness-ot
entries.summary: 最优传输无歧视定价（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：Lindholm 边际化 + 因果路径分解 + Wasserstein
entries.summary_en: Optimal-transport fair pricing (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): Lindholm marginalisation, causal path decomposition, Wasserstein
entries.summary_hk: 最優傳輸無歧視定價（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：Lindholm 邊際化 + 因果路徑分解 + Wasserstein
entries.body: insurance-fairness-ot（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做最优传输（OT）的无歧视定价：Lindholm 边际化（把受保护属性的影响边际化掉）、因果路径分解、Wasserstein 距离度量——公平定价的数学化。对 RIAA：公平定价的三种范式——[[]]（审计）、[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]（LDP 局部差分隐私）、本包（OT 变换定价）；「如何在不看受保护属性的前提下消除歧视」是 OT 的回答（分布变换）；[[insurance-fairness]] 家族的进阶工具；适合公平性研究方向的 RIAA 学生。
entries.body_en: insurance-fairness-ot (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does optimal-transport (OT) discrimination-free pricing: Lindholm marginalisation (marginalising out protected attributes), causal path decomposition, Wasserstein distance — a mathematical treatment of fair pricing. For RIAA: three paradigms of fair pricing — auditing ([[insurance-fairness]]), LDP ([[insurance-fairness-ldp]]), and this package (OT-transformed pricing); 'how to remove discrimination without ever looking at the protected attribute' is OT's answer (distribution transport); an advanced tool of the fairness family; suits RIAA students researching fairness.
entries.body_hk: insurance-fairness-ot（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做最優傳輸（OT）的無歧視定價：Lindholm 邊際化（把受保護屬性的影響邊際化掉）、因果路徑分解、Wasserstein 距離度量——公平定價的數學化。對 RIAA：公平定價的三種範式——審計（[[insurance-fairness]]）、LDP（[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]）、本包（OT 變換定價）；「如何在不看受保護屬性的前提下消除歧視」是 OT 的回答（分佈變換）；[[insurance-fairness]] 家族的進階工具；適合公平性研究方向的 RIAA 學生。

entries.title: insurance-gas
entries.summary: GAS 动态定价（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：广义自回归得分模型，时变参数
entries.summary_en: GAS dynamic pricing (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): generalised autoregressive score models, time-varying parameters
entries.summary_hk: GAS 動態定價（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：廣義自迴歸得分模型，時變參數
entries.body: insurance-gas（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）实现 GAS（Generalised Autoregressive Score）模型：模型参数随得分（似然梯度）自适应演化——动态定价的时变参数方法。对 RIAA：GAS 是动态定价的现代框架（[[insurance-dynamics]] 综合包的核心组件）——比随机游走更有效（利用似然信息）；与 [[insurance-trend]]（趋势）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（变点）配套构成时间维度工具箱；适合车险/家财险的费率时效性建模；score-driven 模型在金融计量与精算之间架桥。
entries.body_en: insurance-gas (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) implements GAS (Generalised Autoregressive Score) models: model parameters adapt via scores (likelihood gradients) — time-varying parameters for dynamic pricing. For RIAA: GAS is the modern framework for dynamic pricing (core component of the [[insurance-dynamics]] suite) — more efficient than random walks (uses likelihood information); with [[insurance-trend]] (trend) and [[insurance-changepoint]] (change points) it forms the time-dimension toolbox; suits rate-timeliness modelling in motor/home; score-driven models bridge financial econometrics and actuarial science.
entries.body_hk: insurance-gas（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）實現 GAS（Generalised Autoregressive Score）模型：模型參數隨得分（似然梯度）自適應演化——動態定價的時變參數方法。對 RIAA：GAS 是動態定價的現代框架（[[insurance-dynamics]] 綜合包的核心組件）——比隨機游走更有效（利用似然信息）；與 [[insurance-trend]]（趨勢）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（變點）配套構成時間維度工具箱；適合車險/家財險的費率時效性建模；score-driven 模型在金融計量與精算之間架橋。

entries.summary: GLM 交互检测（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：自动化交互项发现，UK 定价

entries.body: insurance-interactions（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做 GLM 交互项的自动检测：从数据中发现有意义的交互组合——减少手工搜索交互项的工作。对 RIAA：交互项搜索是定价建模的苦活——手工尝试组合低效且易漏；自动化检测给数据驱动的交互发现（与 [[insurance-pin]] 的 NN 交互建模、[[insurance-glm-tools]] 工具集配套）；「哪些交互值得进模型」兼顾统计显著性与业务可解释性；适合定价建模的效率提升。
entries.body_en: insurance-interactions (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) automates GLM interaction detection: discovering meaningful interaction combinations from data — reducing the manual search for interaction terms. For RIAA: interaction search is the drudgery of pricing modelling — manual combination attempts are inefficient and easy to miss; automated detection gives data-driven interaction discovery (pairs with [[insurance-pin]] NN interaction modelling and [[insurance-glm-tools]]); 'which interactions deserve to enter the model' balances statistical significance with business interpretability; improves pricing modelling efficiency.
entries.body_hk: insurance-interactions（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做 GLM 交互項的自動檢測：從數據中發現有意義的交互組合——減少手工搜索交互項的工作。對 RIAA：交互項搜索是定價建模的苦活——手工嘗試組合低效且易漏；自動化檢測給數據驅動的交互發現（與 [[insurance-pin]] 的 NN 交互建模、[[insurance-glm-tools]] 工具集配套）；「哪些交互值得進模型」兼顧統計顯著性與業務可解釋性；適合定價建模的效率提升。

entries.body: insurance-tmle（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）实现 TMLE（Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation）：双重稳健的因果效应估计——结合倾向得分与结果模型，偏差修正到参数率。对 RIAA：TMLE 是因果推断的方法论支柱（[[insurance-causal]] 家族）——双重稳健（模型之一正确即可）；与 [[insurance-autodml]]（Riesz representer）、[[insurance-bcf]]（贝叶斯因果森林）配套；适合保险场景的因果效应评估（费率政策变化、干预效果）；研究导向的方法论严谨工具。
entries.body_en: insurance-tmle (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) implements TMLE (Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation): doubly robust causal effect estimation — combining propensity scores and outcome models with bias correction to parametric rates. For RIAA: TMLE is a methodological pillar of causal inference ([[insurance-causal]] family) — doubly robust (valid if either model is correct); pairs with [[insurance-autodml]] (Riesz representers) and [[insurance-bcf]] (Bayesian causal forests); suits causal effect evaluation in insurance (rate policy changes, intervention effects); a research-oriented rigorous tool.
entries.body_hk: insurance-tmle（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）實現 TMLE（Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation）：雙重穩健的因果效應估計——結合傾向得分與結果模型，偏差修正到參數率。對 RIAA：TMLE 是因果推斷的方法論支柱（[[insurance-causal]] 家族）——雙重穩健（模型之一正確即可）；與 [[insurance-autodml]]（Riesz representer）、[[insurance-bcf]]（貝葉斯因果森林）配套；適合保險場景的因果效應評估（費率政策變化、干預效果）；研究導向的方法論嚴謹工具。

entries.summary_en: Proxy discrimination diagnostics (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): LRTW 2026 D_proxy, OT distances, fairness diagnostic metrics
entries.summary_hk: 代理歧視診斷（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：LRTW 2026 D_proxy、OT 距離、公平性診斷指標
entries.body: insurance-fairness-diag（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做代理歧视（proxy discrimination）诊断：LRTW 2026 的 D_proxy 指标、最优传输（OT）距离、公平性诊断指标集——量化定价模型中「代理歧视」的程度。对 RIAA：公平性审计的度量层——[[insurance-fairness]]（审计框架）、[[insurance-mediation]]（因果分解）、[[insurance-fairness-ot]]（OT 定价）之外，本包提供可计算的诊断指标；「歧视程度可测量」是监管合规的前提（FCA Consumer Duty）；与 [[insurance-governance]] 配套；适合公平性方向的研究与实务。
entries.body_en: insurance-fairness-diag (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does proxy discrimination diagnostics: the LRTW 2026 D_proxy metric, optimal-transport (OT) distances, a set of fairness diagnostic metrics — quantifying the degree of proxy discrimination in pricing models. For RIAA: the measurement layer of fairness auditing — beyond [[insurance-fairness]] (audit framework), [[insurance-mediation]] (causal decomposition) and [[insurance-fairness-ot]] (OT pricing), this package provides computable diagnostic metrics; 'discrimination being measurable' is a prerequisite for regulatory compliance (FCA Consumer Duty); pairs with [[insurance-governance]]; suits fairness research and practice.
entries.body_hk: insurance-fairness-diag（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做代理歧視（proxy discrimination）診斷：LRTW 2026 的 D_proxy 指標、最優傳輸（OT）距離、公平性診斷指標集——量化定價模型中「代理歧視」的程度。對 RIAA：公平性審計的度量層——[[insurance-fairness]]（審計框架）、[[insurance-mediation]]（因果分解）、[[insurance-fairness-ot]]（OT 定價）之外，本包提供可計算的診斷指標；「歧視程度可測量」是監管合規的前提（FCA Consumer Duty）；與 [[insurance-governance]] 配套；適合公平性方向的研究與實務。

entries.body: insurance-calibration（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做定价模型的校准检验：平衡性质（balance property）测试、auto-calibration 曲线、Murphy 评分分解——模型预测是否可信的严谨检验。对 RIAA：校准（校准 = 预测概率与实际频率一致）是精算模型的核心质量标准——频率模型的平衡性质（组合预测总和 = 实际损失）是精算独有的检验；与 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移检测）、[[insurance-governance]]（验证报告）配套；「校准 vs 判别」的区分是模型评估的精髓。
entries.body_en: insurance-calibration (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) tests pricing model calibration: balance property tests, auto-calibration curves, Murphy score decomposition — rigorous checks of whether model predictions are trustworthy. For RIAA: calibration (predictions matching actual frequencies) is the core quality standard of actuarial models — the balance property of frequency models (sum of portfolio predictions = actual losses) is actuarial-specific; pairs with [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift) and [[insurance-governance]] (validation reports); the calibration-vs-discrimination distinction is the essence of model evaluation.
entries.body_hk: insurance-calibration（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做定價模型的校準檢驗：平衡性質（balance property）測試、auto-calibration 曲線、Murphy 評分分解——模型預測是否可信的嚴謹檢驗。對 RIAA：校準（校準 = 預測概率與實際頻率一致）是精算模型的核心質量標準——頻率模型的平衡性質（組合預測總和 = 實際損失）是精算獨有的檢驗；與 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移檢測）、[[insurance-governance]]（驗證報告）配套；「校準 vs 判別」的區分是模型評估的精髓。

entries.title: insurance-causal-policy
entries.summary: SDID 因果政策评估（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.2）：Synthetic Difference-in-Differences 费率干预评估
entries.summary_en: SDID causal policy evaluation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.2): synthetic difference-in-differences for rate interventions
entries.summary_hk: SDID 因果政策評估（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.2）：Synthetic Difference-in-Differences 費率干預評估
entries.body: insurance-causal-policy（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.2）用 Synthetic Difference-in-Differences（SDID）评估费率政策干预的因果效应：事件研究、对照组合成——费率变更前后对比的严谨化。对 RIAA：费率政策变化的效果评估是精算日常（新费率上线后效果如何？）——[[insurance-causal]] 家族的政策评估分支；SDID 结合 DID 与合成控制（Arkhangelsky et al. 2021）；与 [[insurance-rdd]]（断点回归）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；适合定价决策的效果验证。
entries.body_en: insurance-causal-policy (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.2) uses Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to evaluate the causal effect of rate policy interventions: event studies, synthetic control groups — rigorous before/after comparison of rate changes. For RIAA: evaluating the effect of rate policy changes is daily actuarial work (how did the new rate perform?) — the policy-evaluation branch of the [[insurance-causal]] family; SDID combines DID and synthetic control (Arkhangelsky et al. 2021); pairs with [[insurance-rdd]] (regression discontinuity) and [[insurance-uplift]] (HTE); suits effect validation of pricing decisions.
entries.body_hk: insurance-causal-policy（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.2）用 Synthetic Difference-in-Differences（SDID）評估費率政策干預的因果效應：事件研究、對照組合成——費率變更前後對比的嚴謹化。對 RIAA：費率政策變化的效果評估是精算日常（新費率上線後效果如何？）——[[insurance-causal]] 家族的政策評估分支；SDID 結合 DID 與合成控制（Arkhangelsky et al. 2021）；與 [[insurance-rdd]]（斷點迴歸）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；適合定價決策的效果驗證。

entries.body: insurance-conformal-claims（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索赔回归的无模型 conformal 预测区间：Hong 顺序统计量短区间——分布无关的覆盖保证。对 RIAA：conformal 家族的分支——[[insurance-conformal]]（Tweedie/Poisson 区间）之外针对索赔回归的变体；「短区间 + 覆盖保证」是 conformal 的核心权衡；与 [[insurance-conformal-risk]]（风险控制）、[[insurance-conformal-ts]]（时序）配套；适合预测区间方向的研究型学生。
entries.body_en: insurance-conformal-claims (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does model-free conformal prediction intervals for claims regression: Hong order-statistic short intervals — distribution-free coverage guarantees. For RIAA: a branch of the conformal family — variants for claims regression beyond [[insurance-conformal]] (Tweedie/Poisson intervals); 'short intervals + coverage guarantee' is the core conformal trade-off; pairs with [[insurance-conformal-risk]] (risk control) and [[insurance-conformal-ts]] (time series); suits research-oriented students in prediction intervals.
entries.body_hk: insurance-conformal-claims（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索賠迴歸的無模型 conformal 預測區間：Hong 順序統計量短區間——分佈無關的覆蓋保證。對 RIAA：conformal 家族的分支——[[insurance-conformal]]（Tweedie/Poisson 區間）之外針對索賠迴歸的變體；「短區間 + 覆蓋保證」是 conformal 的核心權衡；與 [[insurance-conformal-risk]]（風險控制）、[[insurance-conformal-ts]]（時序）配套；適合預測區間方向的研究型學生。

entries.summary_en: Conformal fraud detection (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): BH FDR control, integrated conformal anomaly detection
entries.summary_hk: Conformal 欺詐檢測（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：BH FDR 控制、集成 conformal 異常檢測
entries.body: insurance-conformal-fraud（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索赔欺诈的 conformal 异常检测：BH（Benjamini-Hochberg）FDR 控制、集成 conformal 评分——欺诈标记的分布无关保证。对 RIAA：欺诈检测的统计保证——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族在欺诈场景的应用（异常 = 低 conformal 分数）；FDR 控制保证误报率可控（欺诈调查资源有限）；与公平性、治理（[[insurance-governance]]）配套；适合欺诈检测与异常检测方向。
entries.body_en: insurance-conformal-fraud (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does conformal anomaly detection for claims fraud: BH (Benjamini-Hochberg) FDR control, integrated conformal scoring — distribution-free guarantees for fraud flagging. For RIAA: statistical guarantees for fraud detection — the [[insurance-conformal]] family applied to fraud (anomaly = low conformal score); FDR control bounds the false-positive rate (fraud investigation resources are limited); pairs with fairness and governance ([[insurance-governance]]); suits fraud and anomaly detection directions.
entries.body_hk: insurance-conformal-fraud（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做索賠欺詐的 conformal 異常檢測：BH（Benjamini-Hochberg）FDR 控制、集成 conformal 評分——欺詐標記的分佈無關保證。對 RIAA：欺詐檢測的統計保證——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族在欺詐場景的應用（異常 = 低 conformal 分數）；FDR 控制保證誤報率可控（欺詐調查資源有限）；與公平性、治理（[[insurance-governance]]）配套；適合欺詐檢測與異常檢測方向。

entries.title: insurance-conformal-risk
entries.summary: Conformal Risk Control（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保费充足性的期望损失保证
entries.summary_en: Conformal Risk Control (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): expected-loss guarantees for premium sufficiency
entries.summary_hk: Conformal Risk Control（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保費充足性的期望損失保證
entries.body: insurance-conformal-risk（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）实现 Conformal Risk Control：分布无关的期望损失保证——设置区间使期望风险（如保费充足性缺口）有界。对 RIAA：从「覆盖率保证」到「损失保证」的进阶——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的控制版（Angelopoulos et al. 2023）；保费充足性场景（准备金/定价区间需要尾部充足）；与 [[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-quantile]]（尾部）配套；适合风险管理方向的进阶工具。
entries.body_en: insurance-conformal-risk (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) implements Conformal Risk Control: distribution-free expected-loss guarantees — setting intervals so that expected risk (e.g. premium sufficiency shortfall) is bounded. For RIAA: the step from 'coverage guarantees' to 'loss guarantees' — the control version of the [[insurance-conformal]] family (Angelopoulos et al. 2023); premium sufficiency scenarios (reserving/pricing intervals need tail sufficiency); pairs with [[insurance-conformal-claims]] and [[insurance-quantile]] (tails); an advanced tool for risk management.
entries.body_hk: insurance-conformal-risk（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）實現 Conformal Risk Control：分佈無關的期望損失保證——設置區間使期望風險（如保費充足性缺口）有界。對 RIAA：從「覆蓋率保證」到「損失保證」的進階——[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的控制版（Angelopoulos et al. 2023）；保費充足性場景（準備金/定價區間需要尾部充足）；與 [[insurance-conformal-claims]]、[[insurance-quantile]]（尾部）配套；適合風險管理方向的進階工具。

entries.body: insurance-conformal-ts（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做非可交换（non-exchangeable）保险索赔时间序列的 conformal 预测区间：ACK/Aggregate Conformal——数据分布随时间变化时的覆盖保证。对 RIAA：保险数据是时序的（分布漂移）——标准 conformal 假设可交换性，本包处理非可交换场景（[[insurance-conformal]] 的时序分支）；与 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移检测）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（变点）配套；适合准备金/定价的时序预测区间。
entries.body_en: insurance-conformal-ts (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.0) does conformal prediction intervals for non-exchangeable insurance claims time series: ACK/Aggregate Conformal — coverage guarantees when the data distribution shifts over time. For RIAA: insurance data is time-ordered (distributions drift) — standard conformal assumes exchangeability, this package handles non-exchangeable settings (the time-series branch of [[insurance-conformal]]); pairs with [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift) and [[insurance-changepoint]] (change points); suits time-series prediction intervals for reserving/pricing.
entries.body_hk: insurance-conformal-ts（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做非可交換（non-exchangeable）保險索賠時間序列的 conformal 預測區間：ACK/Aggregate Conformal——數據分佈隨時間變化時的覆蓋保證。對 RIAA：保險數據是時序的（分佈漂移）——標準 conformal 假設可交換性，本包處理非可交換場景（[[insurance-conformal]] 的時序分支）；與 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移檢測）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（變點）配套；適合準備金/定價的時序預測區間。

entries.summary_en: Multivariate conformal (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): LWC/GWC/Bonferroni joint prediction regions
entries.summary_hk: 多輸出 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：LWC/GWC/Bonferroni 聯合預測區域
entries.body: insurance-multivariate-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做多输出保险模型的联合 conformal 预测区域：LWC（Lee et al.）、GWC、Bonferroni 方法——多个预测目标同时覆盖的保证。对 RIAA：保险模型常多输出（频率 + 严重度、多个险种）——联合覆盖（所有输出同时正确）比逐个区间更难；[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的高维分支；与 [[insurance-dependent-fs]]（频率-严重度联合）配套；适合多目标预测的研究场景。
entries.body_en: insurance-multivariate-conformal (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does joint conformal prediction regions for multi-output insurance models: LWC (Lee et al.), GWC, Bonferroni methods — guarantees that multiple prediction targets are covered simultaneously. For RIAA: insurance models are often multi-output (frequency + severity, multiple lines) — joint coverage (all outputs correct at once) is harder than per-output intervals; the high-dimensional branch of the [[insurance-conformal]] family; pairs with [[insurance-dependent-fs]] (joint frequency-severity); suits multi-target prediction research.
entries.body_hk: insurance-multivariate-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做多輸出保險模型的聯合 conformal 預測區域：LWC（Lee et al.）、GWC、Bonferroni 方法——多個預測目標同時覆蓋的保證。對 RIAA：保險模型常多輸出（頻率 + 嚴重度、多個險種）——聯合覆蓋（所有輸出同時正確）比逐個區間更難；[[insurance-conformal]] 家族的高維分支；與 [[insurance-dependent-fs]]（頻率-嚴重度聯合）配套；適合多目標預測的研究場景。

entries.summary_en: Spatial conformal (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): spatially weighted conformal intervals, geographically calibrated
entries.summary_hk: 空間 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：地理校準的空間加權 conformal 區間
entries.body: insurance-spatial-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空间加权的 conformal 预测区间：地理校准——相邻地区的校准权重（[[insurance-spatial]] 的区间版本）。对 RIAA：空间数据的校准——地区样本量小导致区间不稳定，空间加权借用邻近地区信息（[[insurance-conformal]] + [[insurance-spatial]] 的交叉）；与 [[insurance-multilevel]]（随机效应）配套；适合地域建模的预测区间。
entries.body_en: insurance-spatial-conformal (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does spatially weighted conformal prediction intervals: geographically calibrated — calibration weights from neighbouring regions (the interval version of [[insurance-spatial]]). For RIAA: calibration under spatial data — small regional samples destabilise intervals, spatial weighting borrows neighbouring information (the intersection of [[insurance-conformal]] and [[insurance-spatial]]); pairs with [[insurance-multilevel]] (random effects); suits prediction intervals in territory modelling.
entries.body_hk: insurance-spatial-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空間加權的 conformal 預測區間：地理校準——相鄰地區的校準權重（[[insurance-spatial]] 的區間版本）。對 RIAA：空間數據的校準——地區樣本量小導致區間不穩定，空間加權借用鄰近地區信息（[[insurance-conformal]] + [[insurance-spatial]] 的交叉）；與 [[insurance-multilevel]]（隨機效應）配套；適合地域建模的預測區間。

entries.body: insurance-counterfactual-sets（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做个体反事实（counterfactual）的加权 conformal 预测集：Lei & Candès 方法——个体处理效应的分布无关置信集。对 RIAA：因果推断 + conformal 的交叉——[[insurance-causal]]（个体因果效应）与 [[insurance-conformal]]（分布无关保证）结合；「对这个人，干预的效应区间是多少」；与 [[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）、[[insurance-bcf]]（贝叶斯因果森林）配套；研究前沿（Lei & Candès 2021）。
entries.body_en: insurance-counterfactual-sets (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does weighted conformal prediction sets for individual counterfactuals: the Lei & Candès method — distribution-free confidence sets for individual treatment effects. For RIAA: the intersection of causal inference and conformal — [[insurance-causal]] (individual causal effects) meets [[insurance-conformal]] (distribution-free guarantees); 'what is the effect interval of the intervention for this person'; pairs with [[insurance-uplift]] (HTE) and [[insurance-bcf]] (Bayesian causal forests); research frontier (Lei & Candès 2021).
entries.body_hk: insurance-counterfactual-sets（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做個體反事實（counterfactual）的加權 conformal 預測集：Lei & Candès 方法——個體處理效應的分佈無關置信集。對 RIAA：因果推斷 + conformal 的交叉——[[insurance-causal]]（個體因果效應）與 [[insurance-conformal]]（分佈無關保證）結合；「對這個人，干預的效應區間是多少」；與 [[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）、[[insurance-bcf]]（貝葉斯因果森林）配套；研究前沿（Lei & Candès 2021）。

entries.summary_en: Covariate shift correction (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.4): density ratio correction for model portability across books
entries.summary_hk: 協變量漂移修正（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.4）：密度比修正，定價模型跨業務遷移
entries.body: insurance-covariate-shift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做协变量漂移的密度比修正：定价模型跨业务组合迁移（新书 vs 旧书分布不同）时的重加权——模型可移植性。对 RIAA：模型迁移是保险实务常态（用旧书数据训练、部署到新书）——协变量漂移使模型失真；密度比修正（CatBoost/RuLSIF 估计）重加权训练数据；与 [[insurance-transfer]]（迁移学习）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移检测）配套；适合模型部署与迁移场景。
entries.body_en: insurance-covariate-shift (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.4) does density-ratio correction for covariate shift: reweighting when pricing models migrate across books (new vs old portfolio distributions differ) — model portability. For RIAA: model migration is the norm in practice (train on old book, deploy to new book) — covariate shift distorts models; density ratio correction (CatBoost/RuLSIF estimation) reweights training data; pairs with [[insurance-transfer]] (transfer learning) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift detection); suits model deployment and migration.
entries.body_hk: insurance-covariate-shift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做協變量漂移的密度比修正：定價模型跨業務組合遷移（新書 vs 舊書分佈不同）時的重加權——模型可移植性。對 RIAA：模型遷移是保險實務常態（用舊書數據訓練、部署到新書）——協變量漂移使模型失真；密度比修正（CatBoost/RuLSIF 估計）重加權訓練數據；與 [[insurance-transfer]]（遷移學習）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移檢測）配套；適合模型部署與遷移場景。

entries.body: insurance-lda-risk（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 LDA（潜在狄利克雷分配）做组合风险画像：潜在风险原型（archetypes）、组合构成漂移分析——把组合分解为可解释的风险主题。对 RIAA：组合层面的风险理解——LDA 从文本/分类数据提取风险主题（[[insurance-governance]] 组合视角）；「组合在往哪个风险方向漂移」是监测问题（[[insurance-monitoring]] 配套）；主题模型的精算应用；适合组合风险与产品管理方向。
entries.body_en: insurance-lda-risk (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses LDA (latent Dirichlet allocation) for portfolio risk profiling: latent risk archetypes, portfolio mix-drift analytics — decomposing the portfolio into interpretable risk topics. For RIAA: portfolio-level risk understanding — LDA extracts risk topics from textual/categorical data (the [[insurance-governance]] portfolio view); 'which risk direction is the portfolio drifting toward' is a monitoring question (pairs with [[insurance-monitoring]]); topic modelling applied to actuarial work; suits portfolio risk and product management.

entries.body: insurance-transfer（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做薄细分段的迁移学习：GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer——把厚数据段的知识迁移到薄段（与 [[insurance-thin-data]] 配套的工程实现）。对 RIAA：薄数据问题是定价核心痛点——[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯路线）、本包（迁移学习路线）两种解法（另有基础模型路线）；迁移学习用「相关段数据」帮助薄段估计；与 [[insurance-covariate-shift]]（分布差异处理）配套；适合薄段定价的研究与实务。
entries.body_en: insurance-transfer (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does transfer learning for thin segments: GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer — transferring knowledge from thick data segments to thin ones (the engineering companion of [[insurance-thin-data]]). For RIAA: the thin-data problem is a core pricing pain point — two solutions (plus a foundation-model route): [[bayesian-pricing]] (Bayesian), this package (transfer learning); transfer learning uses related-segment data to help thin-segment estimation; pairs with [[insurance-covariate-shift]] (distributional differences); suits thin-segment pricing research and practice.

entries.summary: Bunching 估计量（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：费率阈值博弈检测、暴露加权密度扭曲
entries.summary_en: Bunching estimators (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): insurance threshold gaming detection, exposure-weighted density distortions
entries.summary_hk: Bunching 估計量（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：費率閾值博弈檢測、暴露加權密度扭曲
entries.body: insurance-bunching（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 bunching 估计量检测费率阈值博弈：暴露加权的密度扭曲分析——客户是否在费率阈值处策略性聚集（threshold gaming）。对 RIAA：阈值博弈是费率设计的实务问题（客户绕阈值调整行为）——[[insurance-rdd]]（断点回归）检测阈值效应、bunching 检测「密度堆积」；行为反应建模（客户对费率的策略性反应）；与 [[insurance-fairness]]（阈值公平）配套；适合定价行为经济学方向。
entries.body_en: insurance-bunching (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) uses bunching estimators to detect rate-threshold gaming: exposure-weighted density distortion analysis — whether customers strategically cluster at rate thresholds. For RIAA: threshold gaming is a practical rate-design problem (customers adjust behaviour around thresholds) — [[insurance-rdd]] (regression discontinuity) detects threshold effects, bunching detects 'density heaps'; behavioural response modelling (strategic customer reactions to rates); pairs with [[insurance-fairness]] (threshold fairness); suits behavioural economics of pricing.
entries.body_hk: insurance-bunching（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）用 bunching 估計量檢測費率閾值博弈：暴露加權的密度扭曲分析——客戶是否在費率閾值處策略性聚集（threshold gaming）。對 RIAA：閾值博弈是費率設計的實務問題（客戶繞閾值調整行為）——[[insurance-rdd]]（斷點迴歸）檢測閾值效應、bunching 檢測「密度堆積」；行為反應建模（客戶對費率的策略性反應）；與 [[insurance-fairness]]（閾值公平）配套；適合定價行為經濟學方向。

entries.body: credibility（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）是现代 Python 的可信度计算实现：Bühlmann、Bühlmann-Straub 可信度权重——非寿险定价的经典方法现代化。对 RIAA：可信度理论是精算核心（[[insurance-credibility]] 家族的现代实现）——[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯分层）是延伸、本包是经典权重直接计算；与 [[insurance-experience]]（经验费率）配套；适合理解可信度理论的现代工程实践；经典方法 + 现代工程（clean API）的示范。

For RIAA: credibility theory is core actuarial science (the modern implementation of the [[insurance-credibility]] family) — [[bayesian-pricing]] (hierarchical Bayesian) is the extension, this package computes the classical weights directly; pairs with [[insurance-experience]] (experience rating); suits understanding credibility theory through modern engineering; a demonstration of classical methods + modern engineering (clean API).

entries.summary: 免费 12 模块课程（burning-cost）：现代保险定价 + Python/Databricks——GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/贝叶斯可信度/约束优化
entries.summary_en: Free 12-module course (burning-cost): modern insurance pricing with Python/Databricks — GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/Bayesian credibility/constrained optimisation
entries.summary_hk: 免費 12 模塊課程（burning-cost）：現代保險定價 + Python/Databricks——GLM/GBM/SHAP/conformal/貝葉斯可信度/約束優化
entries.body: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks（burning-cost 官方课程）是免费 12 模块实操课程：从 Databricks 基础到生产级费率复核管道——GLM、GBM、SHAP 相对数、conformal 预测、贝叶斯可信度、约束费率优化、因果需求建模、空间领土费率。对 RIAA：定价方向的系统化自学路径——把 burning-cost 家族散落的工具（[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[bayesian-pricing]]、[[insurance-optimise]]）串成完整课程；面向 Emblem/Radar 从业者的迁移路线；与 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 配套（两者互补，本课程更深更工程化）；免费 + 开源是最大优势。
entries.body_en: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks (the burning-cost official course) is a free 12-module hands-on course: from Databricks basics to a production-grade rate review pipeline — GLMs, GBMs, SHAP relativities, conformal prediction, Bayesian credibility, constrained rate optimisation, causal demand modelling and spatial territory rating. For RIAA: a systematic self-study path for pricing — weaving the family's scattered tools ([[insurance-distributional-glm]], [[insurance-gam]], [[insurance-conformal]], [[bayesian-pricing]], [[insurance-optimise]]) into a complete course; a migration route for Emblem/Radar practitioners; complements [[insurance-pricing-course]] (this one is deeper and more engineering-oriented); free and open-source is the biggest win.
entries.body_hk: Modern Insurance Pricing with Python and Databricks（burning-cost 官方課程）是免費 12 模塊實操課程：從 Databricks 基礎到生產級費率複核管道——GLM、GBM、SHAP 相對數、conformal 預測、貝葉斯可信度、約束費率優化、因果需求建模、空間領土費率。對 RIAA：定價方向的系統化自學路徑——把 burning-cost 家族散落的工具（[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[bayesian-pricing]]、[[insurance-optimise]]）串成完整課程；面向 Emblem/Radar 從業者的遷移路線；與 [[insurance-pricing-course]] 配套（兩者互補，本課程更深更工程化）；免費 + 開源是最大優勢。

entries.title: insurance-recourse
entries.summary: 算法救济（burning-cost）：FCA Consumer Duty 合规的保费降价建议——保险约束 + 保费单位输出 + 审计报告
entries.summary_en: Algorithmic recourse (burning-cost): FCA Consumer Duty premium-lowering suggestions — insurance constraints, premium-denominated output, audit reports
entries.summary_hk: 算法救濟（burning-cost）：FCA Consumer Duty 合規的保費降價建議——保險約束 + 保費單位輸出 + 審計報告
entries.body: insurance-recourse（burning-cost）做 FCA Consumer Duty（PS22/9）合规的算法救济：回答「我怎么做才能降低保费」——保险原生约束（年龄/索赔史不可改、里程只能降、停车只能改善）、因果结构（改邮编同时改变治安/犯罪/洪水风险）、保费单位输出（£250 装防盗器）、审计报告（保单 ID/模型版本/SHA-256）。对 RIAA：监管透明度的前沿——Consumer Duty 要求向客户解释定价与改进途径；对比通用工具（DiCE/alibi）在抽象特征空间生成反事实、本包是保险定制的；与 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-governance]] 配套；消费者权益视角的精算应用。
entries.body_en: insurance-recourse (burning-cost) does FCA Consumer Duty (PS22/9)-compliant algorithmic recourse: answering 'what can I change to lower my premium' — insurance-native constraints (age/claims history immutable, mileage only decreases, garaging only improves), causal structure (changing postcode changes crime/flood risk jointly), premium-denominated output (£250 immobiliser), audit reports (policyholder ID/model version/SHA-256). For RIAA: the frontier of regulatory transparency — Consumer Duty requires explaining pricing and improvement paths to customers; where generic tools (DiCE/alibi) generate counterfactuals in abstract feature space, this is insurance-customised; pairs with [[insurance-fairness]] and [[insurance-governance]]; actuarial application from the consumer-rights perspective.
entries.body_hk: insurance-recourse（burning-cost）做 FCA Consumer Duty（PS22/9）合規的算法救濟：回答「我怎麼做才能降低保費」——保險原生約束（年齡/索賠史不可改、里程只能降、停車只能改善）、因果結構（改郵編同時改變治安/犯罪/洪水風險）、保費單位輸出（£250 裝防盜器）、審計報告（保單 ID/模型版本/SHA-256）。對 RIAA：監管透明度的前沿——Consumer Duty 要求向客戶解釋定價與改進途徑；對比通用工具（DiCE/alibi）在抽象特徵空間生成反事實、本包是保險定制的；與 [[insurance-fairness]]、[[insurance-governance]] 配套；消費者權益視角的精算應用。

entries.summary_hk: Bandit 定價實驗（burning-cost）：GIPP 合規的在線價格實驗——UCB1/Thompson 採樣
entries.body: insurance-online（burning-cost）做 GIPP 合规的在线定价实验：多臂老虎机（bandit）算法——UCB1、Thompson 采样——在价格 A/B 测试中动态分配流量（探索-利用权衡）。对 RIAA：在线实验的效率革命——传统 A/B 测试浪费流量在次优臂，bandit 动态学习（「边实验边赚钱」）；GIPP（一般保险定价实践）合规约束；与 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（离线因果评估）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；适合定价实验与增长方向。
entries.body_en: insurance-online (burning-cost) does GIPP-compliant online pricing experiments: multi-armed bandit algorithms — UCB1, Thompson sampling — dynamically allocating traffic in price A/B tests (exploration-exploitation trade-off). For RIAA: the efficiency revolution of online experiments — classical A/B testing wastes traffic on suboptimal arms, bandits learn dynamically ('earning while experimenting'); GIPP (general insurance pricing practices) compliance constraints; pairs with [[insurance-causal-policy]] (offline causal evaluation) and [[insurance-uplift]] (HTE); suits pricing experimentation and growth.
entries.body_hk: insurance-online（burning-cost）做 GIPP 合規的在線定價實驗：多臂老虎機（bandit）算法——UCB1、Thompson 採樣——在價格 A/B 測試中動態分配流量（探索-利用權衡）。對 RIAA：在線實驗的效率革命——傳統 A/B 測試浪費流量在次優臂，bandit 動態學習（「邊實驗邊賺錢」）；GIPP（一般保險定價實踐）合規約束；與 [[insurance-causal-policy]]（離線因果評估）、[[insurance-uplift]]（HTE）配套；適合定價實驗與增長方向。

entries.summary: 层次预测调和（burning-cost）：PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation，费率层级一致性
entries.summary_en: Hierarchical forecast reconciliation (burning-cost): PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation, rate hierarchy consistency
entries.summary_hk: 層次預測調和（burning-cost）：PremiumWeightedMinTrace/LossRatioReconciliation，費率層級一致性
entries.body: insurance-reconcile（burning-cost）做层次预测调和：PremiumWeightedMinTrace、LossRatioReconciliation——保单/单元/组合/产品层级预测的一致性调整（低层预测之和 = 高层预测）。对 RIAA：费率结构的层级一致性是实务要求——组合预测应等于单元预测之和（否则管理层无法解读）；层次调和（reconciliation）是预测领域的标准方法（Hyndman 学派）；与 [[insurance-calibration]]（校准）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（监测）配套；适合定价/准备金预测的汇总一致性问题。
entries.body_en: insurance-reconcile (burning-cost) does hierarchical forecast reconciliation: PremiumWeightedMinTrace, LossRatioReconciliation — adjusting forecasts across policy/cell/portfolio/product hierarchies so lower-level forecasts sum to higher levels. For RIAA: hierarchy consistency of rate structures is a practical requirement — portfolio forecasts should equal the sum of cell forecasts (or management cannot interpret them); reconciliation is the standard forecast method (Hyndman school); pairs with [[insurance-calibration]] (calibration) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (monitoring); suits aggregation-consistency problems in pricing/reserving forecasts.
entries.body_hk: insurance-reconcile（burning-cost）做層次預測調和：PremiumWeightedMinTrace、LossRatioReconciliation——保單/單元/組合/產品層級預測的一致性調整（低層預測之和 = 高層預測）。對 RIAA：費率結構的層級一致性是實務要求——組合預測應等於單元預測之和（否則管理層無法解讀）；層次調和（reconciliation）是預測領域的標準方法（Hyndman 學派）；與 [[insurance-calibration]]（校準）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（監測）配套；適合定價/準備金預測的匯總一致性問題。

entries.body: insurance-vine-longitudinal（burning-cost）用 D-vine copula 建模多年保单索赔的纵向依赖：同一保单跨年的索赔相关性（[[insurance-copula]] 的时序扩展）。对 RIAA：纵向依赖是多年数据的关键结构——同一司机的今年与明年索赔相关（风险持续性）；D-vine 处理高维时序依赖；与 [[insurance-copula]]（截面依赖）、[[insurance-jlm]]（纵向-生存）配套；适合多年面板数据的定价建模（车险/家财险续保周期数据）。
entries.body_en: insurance-vine-longitudinal (burning-cost) uses D-vine copulas for longitudinal dependence of multi-year policy claims: claim correlation across years for the same policy (the time-series extension of [[insurance-copula]]). For RIAA: longitudinal dependence is a key structure of multi-year data — this year's and next year's claims of the same driver are correlated (risk persistence); D-vines handle high-dimensional temporal dependence; pairs with [[insurance-copula]] (cross-sectional dependence) and [[insurance-jlm]] (longitudinal-survival); suits pricing with multi-year panel data (motor/home renewal cycles).
entries.body_hk: insurance-vine-longitudinal（burning-cost）用 D-vine copula 建模多年保單索賠的縱向依賴：同一保單跨年的索賠相關性（[[insurance-copula]] 的時序擴展）。對 RIAA：縱向依賴是多年數據的關鍵結構——同一司機的今年與明年索賠相關（風險持續性）；D-vine 處理高維時序依賴；與 [[insurance-copula]]（截面依賴）、[[insurance-jlm]]（縱向-生存）配套；適合多年面板數據的定價建模（車險/家財險續保週期數據）。

entries.summary_hk: Julia 金融工具建模（JuliaActuary，42★，MIT）：可組合合約/模型——利率、衍生品、資產-負債建模
entries.body: FinanceModels.jl（JuliaActuary，42★，MIT）提供可组合的合约、模型与函数：简单到复杂的金融工具建模——利率曲线、期权、衍生品、资产-负债匹配（ALM）——Julia 精算生态的核心金融包。对 RIAA：Julia 精算栈的金融侧——[[julia-actuary]]（JuliaActuary 组织）的组成部分，与 LifeContingencies.jl（寿险数学）配套：寿险数学管精算现值、FinanceModels 管投资侧；ALM（资产-负债管理）是寿险/养老金精算的核心课题；42★ 且 2026-08 活跃更新；适合投资与资产负债方向的 Julia 用户。
entries.body_en: FinanceModels.jl (JuliaActuary, 42★, MIT) provides composable contracts, models and functions: modelling simple to complex financial instruments — yield curves, options, derivatives, asset-liability management (ALM) — the core financial package of the Julia actuarial stack. For RIAA: the financial side of the Julia actuarial stack — part of [[julia-actuary]] (JuliaActuary org), paired with LifeContingencies.jl (life maths): life contingencies handle actuarial present values, FinanceModels handles the investment side; ALM is a core topic for life/pension actuaries; 42★ and active (updated 2026-08); suits Julia users in investment and ALM directions.
entries.body_hk: FinanceModels.jl（JuliaActuary，42★，MIT）提供可組合的合約、模型與函數：簡單到複雜的金融工具建模——利率曲線、期權、衍生品、資產-負債匹配（ALM）——Julia 精算生態的核心金融包。對 RIAA：Julia 精算棧的金融側——[[julia-actuary]]（JuliaActuary 組織）的組成部分，與 LifeContingencies.jl（壽險數學）配套：壽險數學管精算現值、FinanceModels 管投資側；ALM（資產-負債管理）是壽險/養老金精算的核心課題；42★ 且 2026-08 活躍更新；適合投資與資產負債方向的 Julia 用戶。

entries.title: LEdecomp
entries.summary: 预期寿命分解（CRAN）：按年龄/死因分解预期寿命——Arriaga 1984 等经典方法
entries.summary_en: Life expectancy decomposition (CRAN): decompose LE by age/cause — Arriaga 1984 and other classical methods
entries.summary_hk: 預期壽命分解（CRAN）：按年齡/死因分解預期壽命——Arriaga 1984 等經典方法
entries.body: LEdecomp（CRAN）做预期寿命的敏感性/分解分析：全因与死因特异的预期寿命分解方法——Arriaga（1984）等经典方法（Ponnapalli 2005 综述）——「寿命变化来自哪个年龄段/哪个死因」的量化。对 RIAA：长寿风险建模的工具——预期寿命分解是人口学精算的标准方法（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 配套）；长寿风险的驱动分解（医疗进步 vs 生活方式）对产品定价/准备金有用；与 [[mortality-table]] 主题配套；适合长寿风险与人口学方向。
entries.body_en: LEdecomp (CRAN) does life expectancy sensitivity/decomposition analysis: all-cause and cause-specific LE decomposition — Arriaga (1984) and other classical methods (surveyed in Ponnapalli 2005) — quantifying 'which ages/causes drive LE changes'. For RIAA: a tool for longevity risk modelling — LE decomposition is the standard demographic-actuarial method (pairs with [[cmi-mortality-projections]] and [[human-mortality-db]]); decomposing longevity drivers (medical progress vs lifestyle) informs product pricing/reserving; related to [[mortality-table]] topics; suits longevity risk and demography.
entries.body_hk: LEdecomp（CRAN）做預期壽命的敏感性/分解分析：全因與死因特異的預期壽命分解方法——Arriaga（1984）等經典方法（Ponnapalli 2005 綜述）——「壽命變化來自哪個年齡段/哪個死因」的量化。對 RIAA：長壽風險建模的工具——預期壽命分解是人口學精算的標準方法（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[human-mortality-db]] 配套）；長壽風險的驅動分解（醫療進步 vs 生活方式）對產品定價/準備金有用；與 [[mortality-table]] 主題配套；適合長壽風險與人口學方向。

entries.summary_hk: UNSW 精算深度學習課程（Pat Laub，10★）：ACTL3143/ACTL5111 講義——精算場景的深度學習教學
entries.body: Deep Learning for Actuaries（Pat Laub，UNSW，10★）是 ACTL3143 & ACTL5111 课程的讲义仓库：面向精算学生的深度学习——从神经网络基础到保险场景应用（理赔预测、定价建模）。对 RIAA：精算深度学习的系统教学资源——[[actuarial-skills]]（Claude 技能）偏 AI 应用、本课程偏深度学习理论+精算场景；UNSW 精算专业（澳洲精算强校）的官方课程材料；与 [[reserving-neural]]（神经准备金）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分布 GLM）配套；10★ 但课程内容价值高（2026-08 仍在更新）；适合自学深度学习的精算学生。
entries.body_en: Deep Learning for Actuaries (Pat Laub, UNSW, 10★) is the lecture repository for courses ACTL3143 & ACTL5111: deep learning for actuarial students — from NN basics to insurance applications (claims prediction, pricing modelling). For RIAA: a systematic teaching resource for actuarial deep learning — [[actuarial-skills]] (Claude skills) leans AI applications, this course leans DL theory + actuarial contexts; official course material from UNSW (a strong Australian actuarial school); pairs with [[reserving-neural]] (neural reserving) and [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (distributional GLM); 10★ but high course-content value (still updated 2026-08); suits actuarial students self-studying DL.
entries.body_hk: Deep Learning for Actuaries（Pat Laub，UNSW，10★）是 ACTL3143 & ACTL5111 課程的講義倉庫：面向精算學生的深度學習——從神經網絡基礎到保險場景應用（理賠預測、定價建模）。對 RIAA：精算深度學習的系統教學資源——[[actuarial-skills]]（Claude 技能）偏 AI 應用、本課程偏深度學習理論+精算場景；UNSW 精算專業（澳洲精算強校）的官方課程材料；與 [[reserving-neural]]（神經準備金）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分佈 GLM）配套；10★ 但課程內容價值高（2026-08 仍在更新）；適合自學深度學習的精算學生。

entries.summary_hk: Property Casualty Data Model（CAS 官方，PyPI）：OMG 標準 256 表保險數據庫模式，SQLAlchemy 秒級部署
entries.body: PCDM（CAS 官方，PyPI 0.1.0）是 Object Management Group（OMG）Property Casualty Data Model 的 SQLAlchemy 实现：256 张表、13 个主题域（当事人/保单/索赔/可保对象/资金/事件/产品等）——模拟保险公司后端的关系数据库模式，秒级部署 SQLite 测试库。对 RIAA：保险数据的标准结构——理解 PCDM 的 13 个主题域 = 理解保险公司的数据全景（[[insurance-governance]] 数据治理视角）；给精算建模提供标准化的数据骨架（频率/严重度建模的字段来源）；与 CAS 组织的其他数据项目配套；适合保险数据工程与数据库设计方向。
entries.body_en: PCDM (CAS official, PyPI 0.1.0) is the SQLAlchemy implementation of the Object Management Group (OMG) Property Casualty Data Model: 256 tables across 13 subject-area models (party/policy/claim/insurable object/money/event/product etc.) — a relational schema mirroring an insurer's backend, with instant SQLite test deployment. For RIAA: the standard structure of insurance data — understanding PCDM's 13 SAMs means understanding an insurer's data panorama (the [[insurance-governance]] data view); provides a standardised data skeleton for actuarial modelling (field sources for frequency/severity); pairs with other data projects in the CAS organisation; suits insurance data engineering and database design.
entries.body_hk: PCDM（CAS 官方，PyPI 0.1.0）是 Object Management Group（OMG）Property Casualty Data Model 的 SQLAlchemy 實現：256 張表、13 個主題域（當事人/保單/索賠/可保對象/資金/事件/產品等）——模擬保險公司後端的關係數據庫模式，秒級部署 SQLite 測試庫。對 RIAA：保險數據的標準結構——理解 PCDM 的 13 個主題域 = 理解保險公司的數據全景（[[insurance-governance]] 數據治理視角）；給精算建模提供標準化的數據骨架（頻率/嚴重度建模的字段來源）；與 CAS 組織的其他數據項目配套；適合保險數據工程與數據庫設計方向。

entries.summary: 精算风险建模模拟（CAS 官方，PyPI）：频率-严重度 Monte Carlo、合成索赔生成、分布拟合、损失进展
entries.summary_en: Actuarial risk modelling and simulation (CAS official, PyPI): frequency-severity Monte Carlo, synthetic claims, distribution fitting, loss development
entries.summary_hk: 精算風險建模模擬（CAS 官方，PyPI）：頻率-嚴重度 Monte Carlo、合成索賠生成、分佈擬合、損失進展
entries.body: ActSim（CAS 官方，PyPI 0.1.0.2）是精算风险建模与模拟包：频率-严重度 Monte Carlo（聚合损失模拟）、合成索赔生成（测试/基准）、分布拟合与优度检验、索赔进展投影（损失发展因子）——意外险数据工作流的工具包。对 RIAA：模拟与合成数据的一站式工具——[[aggregate-python]]（聚合分布）管分布计算、ActSim 管端到端模拟工作流；合成索赔用于模型测试与教学（与 [[insurance-synthetic]] 互补）；损失进展投影衔接准备金主题（[[chainladder-python]] 配套）；CAS 官方维护；适合课程实验与模型验证。
entries.body_en: ActSim (CAS official, PyPI 0.1.0.2) is an actuarial risk modelling and simulation package: frequency-severity Monte Carlo (aggregate loss simulation), synthetic claim generation (testing/benchmarking), distribution fitting with goodness-of-fit, claims development projection (loss development factors) — a toolkit for P&C data workflows. For RIAA: one-stop simulation and synthetic data — [[aggregate-python]] handles distributional computation, ActSim handles end-to-end simulation workflows; synthetic claims for model testing and teaching (complements [[insurance-synthetic]]); development projection links the reserving theme (pairs with [[chainladder-python]]); CAS official maintenance; suits coursework experiments and model validation.
entries.body_hk: ActSim（CAS 官方，PyPI 0.1.0.2）是精算風險建模與模擬包：頻率-嚴重度 Monte Carlo（聚合損失模擬）、合成索賠生成（測試/基準）、分佈擬合與優度檢驗、索賠進展投影（損失發展因子）——意外險數據工作流的工具包。對 RIAA：模擬與合成數據的一站式工具——[[aggregate-python]]（聚合分佈）管分佈計算、ActSim 管端到端模擬工作流；合成索賠用於模型測試與教學（與 [[insurance-synthetic]] 互補）；損失進展投影銜接準備金主題（[[chainladder-python]] 配套）；CAS 官方維護；適合課程實驗與模型驗證。

entries.title: IFoA Tabular Foundation Model Research
entries.summary: IFoA ADSWP 表格基础模型基准研究：TabPFN vs GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost 于精算任务（退保/索赔频率）
entries.summary_en: IFoA ADSWP tabular foundation model benchmark: TabPFN vs GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost on actuarial tasks (lapse/claim frequency)
entries.summary_hk: IFoA ADSWP 表格基礎模型基準研究：TabPFN vs GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost 於精算任務（退保/索賠頻率）
entries.body: IFoA-ADSWP 的 tabular-foundation-model 仓库是英国精算师学会（IFoA）精算数据科学工作组（ADSWP）的研究项目：系统比较表格基础模型 TabPFN（[[tabpfn]]，7861★）与 GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost 在精算任务（退保预测、索赔频率建模）上的表现——核心论文「There's Life in the Old GLM Yet!」。对 RIAA：基础模型能否取代精算传统模型的关键实证——「旧 GLM 仍有生命力」的结论对方法选择有直接指导；与 [[insurance-thin-data]]（薄数据）、[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯）配套；IFoA 官方工作组的证据基（evidence base）；适合理解基础模型在精算中的定位。
entries.body_en: The IFoA-ADSWP tabular-foundation-model repository is the research project of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) Actuarial Data Science Working Party (ADSWP): systematically benchmarking the tabular foundation model TabPFN ([[tabpfn]], 7861★) against GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost on actuarial tasks (lapse prediction, claim frequency modelling) — culminating in the paper 'There's Life in the Old GLM Yet!'. For RIAA: key evidence on whether foundation models can replace classical actuarial models — the 'old GLM still has life' conclusion directly guides method choice; pairs with [[insurance-thin-data]] (thin data) and [[bayesian-pricing]] (Bayesian); an evidence base from an IFoA official working party; suits understanding the role of foundation models in actuarial work.
entries.body_hk: IFoA-ADSWP 的 tabular-foundation-model 倉庫是英國精算師學會（IFoA）精算數據科學工作組（ADSWP）的研究項目：系統比較表格基礎模型 TabPFN（[[tabpfn]]，7861★）與 GLM/CatBoost/XGBoost 在精算任務（退保預測、索賠頻率建模）上的表現——核心論文「There's Life in the Old GLM Yet!」。對 RIAA：基礎模型能否取代精算傳統模型的關鍵實證——「舊 GLM 仍有生命力」的結論對方法選擇有直接指導；與 [[insurance-thin-data]]（薄數據）、[[bayesian-pricing]]（貝葉斯）配套；IFoA 官方工作組的證據基（evidence base）；適合理解基礎模型在精算中的定位。

entries.title: AGBQR
entries.summary: 自适应广义贝叶斯分位数回归（CRAN 0.1.0，Hardy & Korobilis 2026）：分位数级学习率 + HAC 校准 + Gibbs 后验
entries.summary_en: Adaptive generalised Bayesian quantile regression (CRAN 0.1.0, Hardy & Korobilis 2026): quantile-specific learning rates, HAC calibration, Gibbs posterior
entries.summary_hk: 自適應廣義貝葉斯分位數迴歸（CRAN 0.1.0，Hardy & Korobilis 2026）：分位數級學習率 + HAC 校準 + Gibbs 後驗
entries.body: AGBQR（CRAN 0.1.0）实现自适应广义贝叶斯分位数回归：分位数级学习率（不同分位不同学习率）、HAC 校准、Gibbs 后验模拟、后验摘要与预测评估——基于 Hardy & Korobilis（2026）的广义贝叶斯复合分位数回归框架。对 RIAA：贝叶斯分位数回归是风险度量的工具——尾部推断（VaR/高额损失分位）需要专门校准（[[insurance-quantile]] 的贝叶斯侧）；小样本时间序列的后验校准正是保险数据常见场景；与 [[insurance-quantile]]（EQRN 频率学路线）、[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯定价）配套；学术方法（SSRN 6618603）的完整实现，适合风险度量研究方向。
entries.body_en: AGBQR (CRAN 0.1.0) implements adaptive generalised Bayesian quantile regression: quantile-specific learning rates (different rates per quantile level), HAC-based calibration, Gibbs posterior simulation, posterior summaries and predictive evaluation — building on the generalised Bayesian composite quantile regression framework of Hardy & Korobilis (2026). For RIAA: Bayesian quantile regression as a risk-measurement tool — tail inference (VaR, high-loss quantiles) needs dedicated calibration (the Bayesian side of [[insurance-quantile]]); posterior calibration for small/moderate time-series samples is exactly common in insurance data; pairs with [[insurance-quantile]] (EQRN frequentist route) and [[bayesian-pricing]] (Bayesian pricing); a complete implementation of an academic method (SSRN 6618603), suited to risk-measurement research.
entries.body_hk: AGBQR（CRAN 0.1.0）實現自適應廣義貝葉斯分位數迴歸：分位數級學習率（不同分位不同學習率）、HAC 校準、Gibbs 後驗模擬、後驗摘要與預測評估——基於 Hardy & Korobilis（2026）的廣義貝葉斯複合分位數迴歸框架。對 RIAA：貝葉斯分位數迴歸是風險度量的工具——尾部推斷（VaR/高額損失分位）需要專門校準（[[insurance-quantile]] 的貝葉斯側）；小樣本時間序列的後驗校準正是保險數據常見場景；與 [[insurance-quantile]]（EQRN 頻率學路線）、[[bayesian-pricing]]（貝葉斯定價）配套；學術方法（SSRN 6618603）的完整實現，適合風險度量研究方向。

entries.body: actuarialmath（Terence Lim，21★，MIT）实现寿险或有风险（life contingent risks）的核心方法：按 SOA FAM-L（Fundamentals of Actuarial Math - Long-term）考试大纲与 Dickson/Hardy/Waters 教材主题层级建模——配套书《Solving Actuarial Math with Python》（2024）。对 RIAA：寿险数学的 Python 化——[[pylifecontingencies]]（动态生命表+死亡率预测）偏功能、actuarialmath 偏教学大纲覆盖（FAM-L 是 SOA 核心考试）；层级类设计（概念→类）让学习路径清晰；21★ + 配套书 + 2026-07 活跃；适合备考与寿险方向自学。
entries.body_en: actuarialmath (Terence Lim, 21★, MIT) implements core methods for life contingent risks: hierarchical modelling following the SOA FAM-L (Fundamentals of Actuarial Math - Long-term) exam syllabus and Dickson/Hardy/Waters topics — with the companion book 'Solving Actuarial Math with Python' (2024). For RIAA: life maths in Python — [[pylifecontingencies]] (dynamic life tables + mortality forecasting) leans functionality, actuarialmath leans syllabus coverage (FAM-L is a core SOA exam); the hierarchical class design (concept-to-class) makes learning paths clear; 21★ + companion book + active 2026-07; suits exam prep and life-track self-study.

entries.body: MBBEFDLite（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-03 发布）提供 MBBEFD（Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac）分布族的统计函数：概率质量、分布、分位数、随机数生成、矩估计拟合——Bernegger（1997）在保险建模中的经典分布族，零外部依赖。对 RIAA：MBBEFD 是责任险/再保险定价的基础分布——[[insurance-ilf]]（burning-cost 的 MBBEFD 曝光曲线实现，pool 中）管完整工作流、本包是零依赖的分布函数基础；曝光曲线决定「限额越高费率密度越低」的量化；与 [[reinsurance]] 视角配套；适合限额定价与再保险方向。
entries.body_en: MBBEFDLite (CRAN 1.0.0, published 2026-03) provides statistical functions for the MBBEFD (Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac) distribution family: probability mass, distribution, quantile, random variate generation and method-of-moments fitting — the classical family for insurance modelling from Bernegger (1997), with zero external dependencies. For RIAA: MBBEFD is foundational for liability/reinsurance pricing — [[insurance-ilf]] (burning-cost's MBBEFD exposure-curve workflow, in pool) handles the full workflow, this package is the zero-dependency distribution-function base; exposure curves quantify 'higher limits, lower rate density'; pairs with the [[reinsurance]] view; suits limit pricing and reinsurance.
entries.body_hk: MBBEFDLite（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-03 發佈）提供 MBBEFD（Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac）分佈族的統計函數：概率質量、分佈、分位數、隨機數生成、矩估計擬合——Bernegger（1997）在保險建模中的經典分佈族，零外部依賴。對 RIAA：MBBEFD 是責任險/再保險定價的基礎分佈——[[insurance-ilf]]（burning-cost 的 MBBEFD 曝光曲線實現，pool 中）管完整工作流、本包是零依賴的分佈函數基礎；曝光曲線決定「限額越高費率密度越低」的量化；與 [[reinsurance]] 視角配套；適合限額定價與再保險方向。

entries.title: Ergodic Insurance Limits
entries.summary: 遍历经济学保险优化（PyPI，GPL-3.0）：从长期复合增长而非期望值视角找最优保险结构（自留/限额/分层）
entries.summary_en: Ergodic economics insurance optimisation (PyPI, GPL-3.0): optimal insurance structure (retention/limits/layers) from long-term compound growth, not expected value
entries.summary_hk: 遍歷經濟學保險優化（PyPI，GPL-3.0）：從長期複合增長而非期望值視角找最優保險結構（自留/限額/分層）
entries.body: Ergodic Insurance Limits（AlexFiliakov，PyPI ergodic-insurance，GPL-3.0）把遍历经济学（ergodicity economics，Ole Peters 2019）应用于保险优化：传统分析问「期望回收是否超过保费」，本框架问「哪个保险结构最大化公司长期复合增长」——答案常出人意料（解释了为何成熟买家愿付远超期望损失的保费）。对 RIAA：新兴研究方向的 Python 实现——[[rim540]] 破产理论/几何收益的延伸：波动税（volatility tax）让大额损失比期望值暗示的更伤长期增长；自留/限额/分层的优化从时间平均（time average）而非集合平均出发；9★ 但 PyPI 发布 + 研究前沿 + 2026-06 活跃；适合对精算基础理论创新感兴趣的学生。
entries.body_en: Ergodic Insurance Limits (AlexFiliakov, PyPI ergodic-insurance, GPL-3.0) applies ergodicity economics (Ole Peters, 2019) to insurance optimisation: traditional analysis asks 'does expected recovery exceed the premium', this framework asks 'which insurance structure maximises a company's long-term compound growth' — with surprisingly different answers (explaining why sophisticated buyers pay premiums well above expected losses). For RIAA: a Python implementation of an emerging research direction — extending [[rim540]] ruin theory/geometric returns: the volatility tax makes large losses more damaging to long-term growth than expected value suggests; retention/limit/layer optimisation from the time average rather than the ensemble average; 9★ but PyPI-published + research frontier + active 2026-06; suits students interested in foundational actuarial innovation.
entries.body_hk: Ergodic Insurance Limits（AlexFiliakov，PyPI ergodic-insurance，GPL-3.0）把遍歷經濟學（ergodicity economics，Ole Peters 2019）應用於保險優化：傳統分析問「期望回收是否超過保費」，本框架問「哪個保險結構最大化公司長期複合增長」——答案常出人意料（解釋了為何成熟買家願付遠超期望損失的保費）。對 RIAA：新興研究方向的 Python 實現——[[rim540]] 破產理論/幾何收益的延伸：波動稅（volatility tax）讓大額損失比期望值暗示的更傷長期增長；自留/限額/分層的優化從時間平均（time average）而非集合平均出發；9★ 但 PyPI 發佈 + 研究前沿 + 2026-06 活躍；適合對精算基礎理論創新感興趣的學生。
entries.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI ergodic-insurance + README（遍历经济/长期增长优化），未实测

entries.summary_en: Insurance loss triangle manipulation (16★, PyPI 2.3.0, Korra): multi-format I/O, triangle aggregation/extension/filtering/bootstrap
entries.summary_hk: 保險損失三角形操作包（16★，PyPI 2.3.0，Korra）：多格式讀寫、三角形聚合/擴展/過濾/bootstrap
entries.body: Bermuda（LedgerInvesting，16★，PyPI 2.3.0，Korra 出品）是保险损失三角形的表示/操作/探索包：JSON/CSV/Pandas/二进制多格式读写、统一 Triangle 类（不规则/多项目/累计/增量）、Cell 类型（多数据类型+元数据）、汇总/聚合/扩展/过滤/bootstrap。对 RIAA：三角形操作的另一选择——[[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）偏准备金计算、Bermuda 偏三角形数据工程（多格式 + 灵活结构）；bootstrap 三角形支撑随机准备金；与 [[reservingmodels]]、[[imaginator]]（组合模拟）配套；适合准备金数据工程与探索方向。
entries.body_en: Bermuda (LedgerInvesting, 16★, PyPI 2.3.0, by Korra) is a package for the representation, manipulation and exploration of insurance loss triangles: multi-format I/O (JSON/CSV/Pandas/binary), a unified Triangle class (ragged/multi-program/cumulative/incremental), a Cell type (multiple data types + metadata), and aggregation/extension/filtering/bootstrap functionality. For RIAA: another choice for triangle work — [[chainladder-python]] (CAS official) leans reserving computation, Bermuda leans triangle data engineering (multi-format + flexible structure); triangle bootstrapping supports stochastic reserving; pairs with [[reservingmodels]] and [[imaginator]] (portfolio simulation); suits reserving data engineering and exploration.
entries.body_hk: Bermuda（LedgerInvesting，16★，PyPI 2.3.0，Korra 出品）是保險損失三角形的表示/操作/探索包：JSON/CSV/Pandas/二進制多格式讀寫、統一 Triangle 類（不規則/多項目/累計/增量）、Cell 類型（多數據類型+元數據）、匯總/聚合/擴展/過濾/bootstrap。對 RIAA：三角形操作的另一選擇——[[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）偏準備金計算、Bermuda 偏三角形數據工程（多格式 + 靈活結構）；bootstrap 三角形支撐隨機準備金；與 [[reservingmodels]]、[[imaginator]]（組合模擬）配套；適合準備金數據工程與探索方向。

entries.summary: 参数死亡率模型（CRAN 2.2.0）：拟合流行人类死亡率定律、构造生命表、HMD 数据
entries.summary_en: Parametric mortality models (CRAN 2.2.0): fit popular human mortality 'laws', construct life tables, HMD data
entries.summary_hk: 參數死亡率模型（CRAN 2.2.0）：擬合流行人類死亡率定律、構造生命表、HMD 數據
entries.body: MortalityLaws（CRAN 2.2.0）拟合流行的人类死亡率定律（Gompertz/Makeham/Heligman-Pollard 等）、构造完整生命表、从 HMD（Human Mortality Database）加载数据——寿险精算与人口学的标准工具。对 RIAA：死亡率建模的基础包——[[stmomo]]（随机死亡率模型）管 APC 族、MortalityLaws 管参数定律拟合；与 [[human-mortality-db]]（HMD 数据）、[[mortality-table]]（生命表）配套；参数死亡率定律（Gompertz 等）是寿险定价/准备金的经典假设来源；适合寿险方向与人口学。
entries.body_en: MortalityLaws (CRAN 2.2.0) fits popular human mortality 'laws' (Gompertz/Makeham/Heligman-Pollard etc.), constructs complete life tables, loads data from HMD (Human Mortality Database) — a standard tool for life actuarial science and demography. For RIAA: the foundation package for mortality modelling — [[stmomo]] (stochastic mortality) handles APC-family models, MortalityLaws handles parametric law fitting; pairs with [[human-mortality-db]] (HMD data) and [[mortality-table]] (life tables); parametric mortality laws (Gompertz etc.) are the classical assumption source for life pricing/reserving; suits life track and demography.
entries.body_hk: MortalityLaws（CRAN 2.2.0）擬合流行的人類死亡率定律（Gompertz/Makeham/Heligman-Pollard 等）、構造完整生命表、從 HMD（Human Mortality Database）加載數據——壽險精算與人口學的標準工具。對 RIAA：死亡率建模的基礎包——[[stmomo]]（隨機死亡率模型）管 APC 族、MortalityLaws 管參數定律擬合；與 [[human-mortality-db]]（HMD 數據）、[[mortality-table]]（生命表）配套；參數死亡率定律（Gompertz 等）是壽險定價/準備金的經典假設來源；適合壽險方向與人口學。

entries.body: demography（CRAN 2.0.1，Hyndman 团队）提供人口学分析：生命表计算、Lee-Carter 死亡率建模、死亡率/生育率/净迁移的函数数据分析（FDA）、随机人口预测。对 RIAA：人口学精算的核心包——[[stmomo]] 的实现基础之一（Lee-Carter 是其特例）；与 [[human-mortality-db]]（数据）、[[mortalitylaws]]（参数定律）配套；Lee-Carter 是长寿风险建模的起点（[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 同类）；Hyndman（预测领域权威）维护；适合长寿风险与人口学方向。
entries.body_en: demography (CRAN 2.0.1, Hyndman team) provides demographic analysis: lifetable calculations, Lee-Carter mortality modelling, functional data analysis (FDA) of mortality/fertility/net-migration rates, stochastic population forecasting. For RIAA: the core package of demographic actuarial science — one of the implementation bases of [[stmomo]] (Lee-Carter is a special case); pairs with [[human-mortality-db]] (data) and [[mortalitylaws]] (parametric laws); Lee-Carter is the starting point of longevity risk modelling (similar to [[cmi-mortality-projections]]); maintained by Hyndman (an authority in forecasting); suits longevity risk and demography.
entries.body_hk: demography（CRAN 2.0.1，Hyndman 團隊）提供人口學分析：生命表計算、Lee-Carter 死亡率建模、死亡率/生育率/淨遷移的函數數據分析（FDA）、隨機人口預測。對 RIAA：人口學精算的核心包——[[stmomo]] 的實現基礎之一（Lee-Carter 是其特例）；與 [[human-mortality-db]]（數據）、[[mortalitylaws]]（參數定律）配套；Lee-Carter 是長壽風險建模的起點（[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 同類）；Hyndman（預測領域權威）維護；適合長壽風險與人口學方向。

entries.body: MortCast（CRAN 2.8-0）估计并投影分年龄段死亡率：Lee-Carter 及其变体（Kamisto、mortality patterns）、联合国人口司风格的死亡率投影——长寿风险建模的工具。对 RIAA：死亡率投影的工程化——[[stmomo]]（APC 随机族）与 MortCast（联合国方法族）是两条路线；联合国人口司（UN WPP）方法在监管/宏观场景常用；与 [[demography]]、[[mortalitylaws]] 配套；适合长寿风险与人口预测方向。
entries.body_en: MortCast (CRAN 2.8-0) estimates and projects age-specific mortality rates: Lee-Carter and variants (Kamisto, mortality patterns), UN Population Division-style mortality projections — a tool for longevity risk modelling. For RIAA: the engineering of mortality projection — [[stmomo]] (APC stochastic family) and MortCast (UN-methods family) are two routes; UN WPP-style methods are common in regulatory/macro scenarios; pairs with [[demography]] and [[mortalitylaws]]; suits longevity risk and population forecasting.
entries.body_hk: MortCast（CRAN 2.8-0）估計並投影分年齡段死亡率：Lee-Carter 及其變體（Kamisto、mortality patterns）、聯合國人口司風格的死亡率投影——長壽風險建模的工具。對 RIAA：死亡率投影的工程化——[[stmomo]]（APC 隨機族）與 MortCast（聯合國方法族）是兩條路線；聯合國人口司（UN WPP）方法在監管/宏觀場景常用；與 [[demography]]、[[mortalitylaws]] 配套；適合長壽風險與人口預測方向。

entries.body: bage（CRAN 0.10.10）做年龄特定费率的快速贝叶斯估计与预测：分层贝叶斯模型处理年龄-时期-队列结构——死亡率/发病率等率数据。对 RIAA：贝叶斯方法在率数据上的现代实现——[[demography]]（频率学）的贝叶斯对照；年龄-时期-队列（APC）结构的分层建模；与 [[stmomo]]（APC 频率学）、[[pymc]]（贝叶斯引擎）配套；适合长寿风险、健康险的率建模方向。
entries.body_en: bage (CRAN 0.10.10) does fast Bayesian estimation and forecasting of age-specific rates: hierarchical Bayesian models handling age-period-cohort structure — for rate data like mortality/morbidity. For RIAA: a modern Bayesian implementation for rate data — the Bayesian counterpart of [[demography]] (frequentist); hierarchical modelling of age-period-cohort (APC) structure; pairs with [[stmomo]] (frequentist APC) and [[pymc]] (Bayesian engine); suits longevity risk and health rate modelling.

entries.body_en: lifepack (CRAN 0.1.0) calculates insurance reserves and equivalence premiums using advanced numerical methods — a life actuarial tool aimed at accurate financial projections. For RIAA: numerical implementations of reserve calculations — the R counterpart of [[lifelib]] (Python life models); equivalence premiums/reserves are core life pricing ([[rim540]]-relevant); pairs with [[actuarialmath]] (FAM-L syllabus) and [[pylifecontingencies]] (life table functions); suits life track and IFRS 17 reserving topics.
entries.body_hk: lifepack（CRAN 0.1.0）用高級數值方法計算保險準備金與等價保費——面向精確財務預測的壽險精算工具。對 RIAA：準備金計算的數值實現——[[lifelib]]（Python 壽險模型）的 R 對照；等價保費/準備金是壽險定價核心（[[rim540]] 相關）；與 [[actuarialmath]]（FAM-L 大綱）、[[pylifecontingencies]]（生命表功能）配套；適合壽險方向與 IFRS 17 準備金議題。

entries.title: eiopaR
entries.summary: EIOPA 无风险利率曲线（CRAN 0.1.1）：访问 EIOPA 官方 RFR 曲线数据
entries.summary_en: EIOPA risk-free rate curves (CRAN 0.1.1): access official EIOPA RFR curve data
entries.summary_hk: EIOPA 無風險利率曲線（CRAN 0.1.1）：訪問 EIOPA 官方 RFR 曲線數據
entries.body: eiopaR（CRAN 0.1.1）提供对 EIOPA（欧洲保险与职业养老金管理局）无风险利率（RFR）曲线的访问——偿付能力 II 的官方折现曲线数据。对 RIAA：偿付能力 II 折现曲线的一站式获取——[[ggsolvencyii]]（偿付能力可视化）的利率数据源配套；RFR 曲线（含 UFR 外推）是欧盟保险公司准备金的官方折现基准；与 [[insurance-python]]（Smith-Wilson 实现）配套（RFR 外推方法本身）；适合偿付能力与欧盟监管方向。
entries.body_en: eiopaR (CRAN 0.1.1) provides access to EIOPA (European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority) risk-free rate (RFR) curves — the official Solvency II discount curves. For RIAA: one-stop access to Solvency II discount curves — the rate-data companion of [[ggsolvencyii]] (solvency visualisation); RFR curves (with UFR extrapolation) are the official discount basis for EU insurer reserves; pairs with [[insurance-python]] (Smith-Wilson implementation) since UFR extrapolation is the method itself; suits solvency and EU regulation.
entries.body_hk: eiopaR（CRAN 0.1.1）提供對 EIOPA（歐洲保險與職業養老金管理局）無風險利率（RFR）曲線的訪問——償付能力 II 的官方折現曲線數據。對 RIAA：償付能力 II 折現曲線的一站式獲取——[[ggsolvencyii]]（償付能力可視化）的利率數據源配套；RFR 曲線（含 UFR 外推）是歐盟保險公司準備金的官方折現基準；與 [[insurance-python]]（Smith-Wilson 實現）配套（UFR 外推方法本身）；適合償付能力與歐盟監管方向。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v0.1.1，CRAN Task View 收录），未实测

entries.title: clmplus
entries.summary: Chain Ladder Plus 模型（CRAN 1.1.0）：索赔进展的年龄-时期-队列模型工具箱
entries.summary_en: Chain Ladder Plus models (CRAN 1.1.0): age-period-cohort toolbox for claim development
entries.summary_hk: Chain Ladder Plus 模型（CRAN 1.1.0）：索賠進展的年齡-時期-隊列模型工具箱
entries.body: clmplus（CRAN 1.1.0）实现索赔进展的年龄-时期-队列（APC）模型族：Chain Ladder 的推广（Kuang、Nielsen、Nielsen 方法）——把经典的进展因子框架嵌入 APC 结构。对 RIAA：准备金方法的前沿——[[chainladder]]（经典 CL）与 [[stmomo]]（死亡率 APC）在准备金场景的结合；APC 结构识别「年龄-进展期-队列」各自的效应（准备金实务的深层理解）；与 [[reservingmodels]]、[[adlp]]（集成准备金）配套；适合准备金研究方向。
entries.body_en: clmplus (CRAN 1.1.0) implements the age-period-cohort (APC) family of models for claim development: a generalisation of Chain Ladder (Kuang, Nielsen, Nielsen methods) — embedding the classical development-factor framework in APC structure. For RIAA: the frontier of reserving methods — [[chainladder]] (classical CL) meets [[stmomo]] (mortality APC) in the reserving context; APC structure separates the effects of age/development/cohort (deep understanding of reserving practice); pairs with [[reservingmodels]] and [[adlp]] (ensemble reserving); suits reserving research.
entries.body_hk: clmplus（CRAN 1.1.0）實現索賠進展的年齡-時期-隊列（APC）模型族：Chain Ladder 的推廣（Kuang、Nielsen、Nielsen 方法）——把經典的進展因子框架嵌入 APC 結構。對 RIAA：準備金方法的前沿——[[chainladder]]（經典 CL）與 [[stmomo]]（死亡率 APC）在準備金場景的結合；APC 結構識別「年齡-進展期-隊列」各自的效應（準備金實務的深層理解）；與 [[reservingmodels]]、[[adlp]]（集成準備金）配套；適合準備金研究方向。
