entries.body_hk: RiskProfiler 是 OpenDRR（加拿大災害風險降低平台）的 Web 應用：支持災害韌性（disaster resilience）——災害風險畫像（地震/洪水等）與韌性評估。對 RIAA：災害風險畫像的官方平台參考（多災害風險暴露）。與 [[openquake-engine]]、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]]、[[catia]]、[[databricks-flood-prediction]] 互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

entries.title: GEM Global Exposure Model
entries.summary: GEM 全球建筑暴露模型：全球地震/巨灾风险评估的暴露数据基础
entries.body: GEM Global Exposure Model 是全球地震模型基金会（GEM）的全球建筑暴露（exposure）模型：全球建筑存量/价值/居住的暴露数据——地震与多灾害风险评估的暴露层基础。对 RIAA：全球暴露数据的标准源（巨灾建模的『暴露』输入）。与 [[openquake-engine]]（风险引擎）、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]] 互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[spatialextremes]]。

entries.summary_hk: GEM 全球建築暴露模型：全球地震/巨災風險評估的暴露數據基礎
entries.body_en: GEM Global Exposure Model is the Global Earthquake Model Foundation's global building-exposure model: global building stock/value/occupancy exposure data — the exposure-layer foundation for earthquake and multi-hazard risk assessment. For RIAA: the standard source of global exposure data (the 'exposure' input of catastrophe modelling). Complements [[openquake-engine]] (risk engine) and [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]. entries.title: CoMoMo
entries.summary: 堆叠回归集成死亡率预测 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元学习器组合 GAPC 模型
entries.body: CoMoMo（R 包，SSRN 论文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套代码，被 The Actuary 报道）用堆叠回归集成（stacked regression ensemble）组合多个随机死亡率模型的预测：基于 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/弹性网等元学习器在交叉验证元数据上学得动态权重，再外推组合预测。对 RIAA：长寿/死亡率预测的进阶方法——组合多个模型以降低单一模型偏差；与 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法对比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同属死亡率建模工具箱；关联 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/养老场景）。
entries.verified_note: raw README+SSRN 论文核实：堆叠回归集成死亡率预测（Kessy 2021, SSRN 3823511），9★ 学术背书入池
entries.summary_en: R package for mortality forecasting with stacked regression ensembles: Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic metalearners combine GAPC models
entries.summary_hk: 堆疊回歸集成死亡率預測 R 包：Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic 元學習器組合 GAPC 模型
entries.body_en: CoMoMo (R package, companion code to the SSRN paper "Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles", featured in The Actuary) combines the forecasts of several stochastic mortality models via stacked regression ensembles: starting from the GAPC family in [[stmomo]] (LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT), Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/Elastic-net metalearners learn dynamic weights on cross-validated metadata, then extrapolate the combined forecast. For RIAA: an advanced method for longevity/mortality forecasting — combining models to reduce single-model bias; with [[mortalityforecast]] (method comparison) and [[mortalitylaws]] it forms the mortality-modelling toolbox; related: [[longevity]], [[longevity-risk]] (annuity/pension settings).
entries.body_hk: CoMoMo（R 套件，SSRN 論文《Mortality Forecasting Using Stacked Regression Ensembles》配套程式碼，獲 The Actuary 報道）以堆疊回歸集成組合多個隨機死亡率模型的預測：基於 [[stmomo]] 的 GAPC 模型族（LC/APC/CBD/M7/RH/PLAT），用 Ridge/Lasso/NNLS/彈性網等元學習器在交叉驗證元數據上學習動態權重，再外推組合預測。對 RIAA：長壽/死亡率預測的進階方法——組合多個模型以降低單一模型偏差；與 [[mortalityforecast]]（方法對比框架）、[[mortalitylaws]] 同屬死亡率建模工具箱；關聯 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]（年金/退休場景）。

entries.title: MxDevTool (Python)
entries.summary: 金融分析综合库（37★，Beta）：经济情景生成器 Xenarix + ALM + 定价，基于 QuantLib-Python
entries.body: MxDevTool（montrixdev/mxdevtool-python，Beta）是基于 [[quantlib]] 的 Python 金融分析集成开发工具：内置经济情景生成器（ESG，Xenarix 已并入子模块）、资产负债管理（ALM）、随机数生成（MersenneTwister/Sobol）与矩匹配（Moment-Matching）过程。对 RIAA：Python 侧 ESG/ALM 工具链——与 [[pyesg]]（通用 ESG）、[[esg-generator-python]]（Solvency II/IFRS 17 负债估值场景）并列；关联 [[esg]]（R 侧 Planchet 等）、[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]（Julia 侧）、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]（情景校验）。

entries.summary_hk: 金融分析綜合庫（37★，Beta）：經濟情景生成器 Xenarix + ALM + 定價，基於 QuantLib-Python
entries.body_en: MxDevTool (montrixdev/mxdevtool-python, Beta) is an integrated Python development tool for financial analysis built on [[quantlib]]: an economic scenario generator (ESG; Xenarix merged in as a submodule), asset-liability management (ALM), random number generators (MersenneTwister/Sobol) and moment-matching processes. For RIAA: a Python-side ESG/ALM toolchain — alongside [[pyesg]] (general-purpose ESG) and [[esg-generator-python]] (Solvency II / IFRS 17 liability-valuation scenarios); related: [[esg]] (R side, Planchet et al.), [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]] (Julia side) and [[hull-white-esg-checks]] (scenario validation).
entries.body_hk: MxDevTool（montrixdev/mxdevtool-python，Beta）是基於 [[quantlib]] 的 Python 金融分析整合開發工具：內置經濟情景生成器（ESG；Xenarix 已併入子模組）、資產負債管理（ALM）、隨機數生成（MersenneTwister/Sobol）與矩匹配（Moment-Matching）過程。對 RIAA：Python 側 ESG/ALM 工具鏈——與 [[pyesg]]（通用 ESG）、[[esg-generator-python]]（Solvency II/IFRS 17 負債估值情景）並列；關聯 [[esg]]（R 側 Planchet 等）、[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]（Julia 側）、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]（情景校驗）。

entries.title: IndividualClaimsSimulator (R)
entries.summary: 个体索赔模拟器（Wüthrich 团队，SSRN 4127073 配套）：准备金研究用个体责任索赔生成器
entries.body: IndividualClaimsSimulator（actuarial-data-science 官方 R 包）是 SSRN 论文《Individual Claims Generator for Claims Reserving Studies: data simulation.R》（Wang & Wüthrich, 4127073）的配套代码：模拟个体责任索赔（个体保单层级的索赔产生与发展），用于准备金研究方法研究——检验 Mack 链梯法/个体索赔模型在模拟数据上的表现。对 RIAA：准备金研究的实验数据生成器——与 [[chainladder]]（经典准备金方法）互补；关联 [[ads-tutorials]]（同组织教程，神经网络精算实战）。

entries.body_en: IndividualClaimsSimulator (official R package of the actuarial-data-science org) is the companion code to the SSRN paper "Individual Claims Generator for Claims Reserving Studies: data simulation.R" (Wang & Wüthrich, 4127073): it simulates individual liability claims (claim generation and development at individual-policy level) for claims-reserving methodology research — e.g. testing Mack chain ladder and individual claims models on simulated data. For RIAA: an experimental data generator for reserving research — complements [[chainladder]] (classical reserving); related: [[ads-tutorials]] (sister tutorials in the same org).

entries.title: StochasticReserving (England)
entries.summary: 随机准备金 R+Python 库（Peter England 官方，13★）：England-Verrall 解析/Bootstrap/MCMC，IFRS 17 与 Solvency II 风险边际
entries.body: StochasticReserving（DrPeterEngland，EMC Actuarial 教育资源）是 Peter England 本人提供的随机准备金代码库（R+Python 双实现）：复现 England & Verrall (2006) 与 England, Verrall & Wüthrich (2018/2019)——未决负债的预测分布、终身与一年（one-year）两个准备金风险视角、解析式/Bootstrap/'贝叶斯' MCMC 三种方法、Mack 模型与 ODP/负二项链梯（常/变尺度）、Solvency II 资本成本风险边际、IFRS 17 风险调整（贴现未决负债分布上的风险度量）。对 RIAA：随机准备金与 IFRS 17/Solvency II 风险边际的权威教学与实现——与 [[chainladder]]（经典确定性方法）、[[individualclaims-simulator]]（个体索赔模拟）、[[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 计量库）、[[solvency2rfr]]（RFR 数据）、[[ggsolvencyii]]（SCR 可视化）同链。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：England & Verrall (2006)/E,V&W (2018) 配套官方代码（R+Python），作者本人提供，学术背书入池
entries.summary_en: Stochastic reserving R+Python library (official, Peter England, 13★): England-Verrall analytic/bootstrap/MCMC, IFRS 17 & Solvency II risk margins
entries.summary_hk: 隨機準備金 R+Python 庫（Peter England 官方，13★）：England-Verrall 解析/Bootstrap/MCMC，IFRS 17 與 Solvency II 風險邊際
entries.body_en: StochasticReserving (DrPeterEngland, an EMC Actuarial educational resource) is the official code repository by Peter England himself (R + Python implementations): it reproduces England & Verrall (2006) and England, Verrall & Wüthrich (2018/2019) — predictive distributions of outstanding liabilities, the lifetime and one-year views of reserve risk, analytic / bootstrap / 'Bayesian' MCMC methods, Mack's model and the ODP / negative-binomial chain ladder (constant and non-constant scale), Solvency II cost-of-capital risk margins, and IFRS 17 risk adjustments (risk measures applied to the distribution of discounted outstanding liabilities). For RIAA: the authoritative teaching-and-implementation resource for stochastic reserving and IFRS 17 / Solvency II risk margins — pairs with [[chainladder]] (classical deterministic methods), [[individualclaims-simulator]] (individual claims simulation), [[ifrs17a]] (IFRS 17 measurement), [[solvency2rfr]] (RFR data) and [[ggsolvencyii]] (SCR visualisation).
entries.body_hk: StochasticReserving（DrPeterEngland，EMC Actuarial 教育資源）是 Peter England 本人提供的隨機準備金程式碼庫（R+Python 雙實現）：復現 England & Verrall (2006) 與 England, Verrall & Wüthrich (2018/2019)——未決負債的預測分佈、終身與一年（one-year）兩個準備金風險視角、解析式/Bootstrap/'貝葉斯' MCMC 三種方法、Mack 模型與 ODP/負二項鏈梯（常/變尺度）、Solvency II 資本成本風險邊際、IFRS 17 風險調整（貼現未決負債分佈上的風險度量）。對 RIAA：隨機準備金與 IFRS 17/Solvency II 風險邊際的權威教學與實現——與 [[chainladder]]（經典確定性方法）、[[individualclaims-simulator]]（個體索償模擬）、[[ifrs17a]]（IFRS 17 計量庫）、[[solvency2rfr]]（RFR 數據）、[[ggsolvencyii]]（SCR 可視化）同鏈。

entries.title: Explainable AI in Fraud Detection
entries.summary: 金融欺诈可解释 AI 全流水线（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自编码器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解释+PSI 漂移
entries.body: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）实现可解释欺诈/异常检测混合流水线：交易图上的图神经网络（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基线）+ 自编码器无监督异常评分，事后可解释性用 SHAP/置换重要性/GNNExplainer 式节点边重要性，另含总体稳定性指数（PSI）漂移追踪与 F1/PR-AUC 阈值优化，带可配置训练 CLI 与单元测试。对 RIAA：反欺诈与异常检测的可解释建模学习——与 [[networkfraud]]（保险欺诈网络分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 图检测样例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解释性方法与 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同属可信 AI 方向。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：GNN+GBDT+AE 混合可解释欺诈流水线（SHAP/PSI/阈值优化），800★
entries.summary_en: Explainable AI pipeline for financial fraud/anomaly detection (800★): GNN + gradient boosting + autoencoder, SHAP/GNNExplainer explanations + PSI drift
entries.summary_hk: 金融欺詐可解釋 AI 全流水線（800★）：GNN+梯度提升+自編碼器，SHAP/GNNExplainer 解釋+PSI 漂移
entries.body_en: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection (jiyuanwang-afk, 800★) implements a hybrid explainable fraud/anomaly-detection pipeline: GNNs over a transaction graph, tabular gradient boosting (baseline) for calibrated probabilities, autoencoders for unsupervised anomaly scoring, post-hoc explainability via SHAP / permutation importance / GNNExplainer-style node-and-edge importance, plus population stability index (PSI) drift tracking and F1/PR-AUC threshold optimisation, with a configurable training CLI and unit tests. For RIAA: learning explainable modelling for fraud and anomaly detection — pairs with [[networkfraud]] (insurance fraud network analysis), [[aws-fraud-graph]] (AWS graph-detection sample) and [[fraud-detection]] (the concept); explainability methods align with [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] in the trustworthy-AI direction.
entries.body_hk: Explainable-AI-in-Financial-Fraud-and-Anomaly-Detection（jiyuanwang-afk，800★）實現可解釋欺詐/異常檢測混合流水線：交易圖上的圖神經網絡（GNN）+ 表格梯度提升（基線）+ 自編碼器無監督異常評分，事後可解釋性用 SHAP/置換重要性/GNNExplainer 式節點邊重要性，另含總體穩定性指數（PSI）漂移追蹤與 F1/PR-AUC 閾值優化，帶可配置訓練 CLI 與單元測試。對 RIAA：反欺詐與異常檢測的可解釋建模學習——與 [[networkfraud]]（保險欺詐網絡分析）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 圖檢測樣例）、[[fraud-detection]]（概念）配套；可解釋性方法與 [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] 同屬可信 AI 方向。

entries.body_en: transitionMatrix (Open Risk, 88★, Apache-2.0) is a Python library for the statistical analysis of state-transition phenomena: it estimates transition matrices from timestamped historical event data (a variety of estimators), manipulates transition matrices (generators, comparisons), visualises event data and transition matrices, and ships standardised test datasets. Typical use cases: credit-rating migrations and multi-state system event logs. For RIAA: multi-state modelling and credit-transition analysis — pairs with [[credit-risk]] (the concept) and [[ifrs9-ecl]] (IFRS 9 impairment); the multi-state angle can be compared with stochastic approaches such as [[stochasticreserving]].

For RIAA: an insurance use case for the new-generation A2A agent protocol — complements [[claims-intake-agent]] (Microsoft AF claims intake), [[claims-processing-hack]] (Foundry hackathon) and [[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]] (multi-agent MCP); the voice+agent direction is an emerging paradigm.

entries.title: ASM FM Formula Trainer

For RIAA: a lightweight formula drill for Exam FM — in the same family as [[examprep-ai]] (AI study roadmap) and [[open-exam-prep]] (IFoA drilling); related: [[soa]] (the exam system), [[actuarialmath]] (life actuarial maths in Python) and [[financialmath]] (financial maths in R).

entries.title: Copulas (SDV, Python)
entries.summary: Python copula 表格合成数据库（SDV 团队）：copula 建模生成合成表格数据
entries.body: Copulas（sdv-dev/Copulas，Python 0.14.1）是 SDV 团队（合成数据领域知名团队）的 copula 建模库：用 copula 创建表格合成数据（Gaussian/Student-t/Clayton/Gumbel 等族），是合成数据生态（SDV）的基础组件。对 RIAA：基于 copula 的合成数据生成——合成理赔/保单数据用于模型开发与隐私保护场景（[[synthetic]] 概念）；与 [[copula-r]]（R 侧标准库）同族，配 [[pyvinecopulib]]（高维藤 copula）；保险合成数据应用可参考 [[soa-ait168-synthetic-claims]]。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 0.14.1 + README 核实：SDV copula 表格合成数据库
entries.summary_en: Python copula library for tabular synthetic data (SDV team): copula-based generation of synthetic tabular data
entries.summary_hk: Python copula 表格合成數據庫（SDV 團隊）：copula 建模生成合成表格數據
entries.body_en: Copulas (sdv-dev/Copulas, Python 0.14.1) is the copula-modelling library of the SDV team (well known in the synthetic-data space): it creates tabular synthetic data with copulas (Gaussian / Student-t / Clayton / Gumbel families), and is a foundation component of the SDV synthetic-data ecosystem. For RIAA: copula-based synthetic-data generation — synthetic claims/policy data for model development and privacy-preserving settings (see the [[synthetic]] concept); same family as [[copula-r]] (the R standard), paired with [[pyvinecopulib]] (high-dimensional vine copulas); insurance synthetic-data applications: see [[soa-ait168-synthetic-claims]].
entries.body_hk: Copulas（sdv-dev/Copulas，Python 0.14.1）是 SDV 團隊（合成數據領域知名團隊）的 copula 建模庫：用 copula 創建表格合成數據（Gaussian/Student-t/Clayton/Gumbel 等族），是合成數據生態（SDV）的基礎組件。對 RIAA：基於 copula 的合成數據生成——合成理賠/保單數據用於模型開發與隱私保護場景（[[synthetic]] 概念）；與 [[copula-r]]（R 側標準庫）同族，配 [[pyvinecopulib]]（高維藤 copula）；保險合成數據應用可參考 [[soa-ait168-synthetic-claims]]。

entries.title: pyvinecopulib
entries.summary: Python 藤 copula 接口（vinecopulib 官方）：高维 vine copula 建模/采样/选择
entries.body: pyvinecopulib（vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib，Python 0.7.6）是 C++ vine copula 库 vinecopulib 的官方 Python 接口：高维藤（vine）copula 的结构选择、参数估计、采样与条件抽样，性能由 C++ 后端保证。对 RIAA：高维相依建模（>2 维）的利器——多风险因子聚合、巨灾多险种组合的相依结构（[[vinecopula-r]] 的 Python 侧）；配 [[copulas-sdv]]（合成数据）与 [[extremes]]（极值）；关联 [[extreme-value-theory]]。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 0.7.6 + 项目页核实：vinecopulib 官方 Python 接口（高维 vine copula）
entries.summary_en: Python interface to vinecopulib (official): high-dimensional vine-copula modelling / sampling / selection
entries.summary_hk: Python 藤 copula 接口（vinecopulib 官方）：高維 vine copula 建模/採樣/選擇
entries.body_en: pyvinecopulib (vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib, Python 0.7.6) is the official Python interface to the C++ vine-copula library vinecopulib: high-dimensional vine-copula structure selection, parameter estimation, sampling and conditional sampling, with performance backed by the C++ core. For RIAA: the go-to tool for high-dimensional dependence modelling (beyond 2D) — dependence structures for multi-risk-factor aggregation and multi-line catastrophe portfolios (the Python side of [[vinecopula-r]]); pairs with [[copulas-sdv]] (synthetic data) and [[extremes]] (extreme values); related: [[extreme-value-theory]].
entries.body_hk: pyvinecopulib（vinecopulib/pyvinecopulib，Python 0.7.6）是 C++ 藤 copula 庫 vinecopulib 的官方 Python 接口：高維藤（vine）copula 的結構選擇、參數估計、採樣與條件抽樣，性能由 C++ 後端保證。對 RIAA：高維相依建模（>2 維）的利器——多風險因子聚合、巨災多險種組合的相依結構（[[vinecopula-r]] 的 Python 側）；配 [[copulas-sdv]]（合成數據）與 [[extremes]]（極值）；關聯 [[extreme-value-theory]]。

entries.title: pyextremes
entries.summary: Python 极值分析库（EVA）：GEV/GPD 拟合、阈值选择、重现期与可视化
entries.body: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是极值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）库：广义极值（GEV）与广义帕累托（GPD）分布拟合（含阈值选择）、重现期计算、年最大/峰值超阈值（POT）两种方法、诊断图与可视化。对 RIAA：保险巨灾与极端损失建模——洪水/风暴/热浪等极端事件的频率-强度-重现期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 应用）；与 [[extremes]]（R 侧标准库）互补，R 侧见 [[copula-r]] 的极值 copula 族。
entries.verified_note: PyPI 2.5.0 + README 核实：Python EVA 库（GEV/GPD/阈值选择/重现期）
entries.summary_en: Python Extreme Value Analysis library: GEV/GPD fitting, threshold selection, return periods and visualisation
entries.summary_hk: Python 極值分析庫（EVA）：GEV/GPD 擬合、閾值選擇、重現期與可視化
entries.body_en: pyextremes (mhostetter/pyextremes, Python 2.5.0) is an Extreme Value Analysis (EVA) library: generalised extreme value (GEV) and generalised Pareto (GPD) fitting with threshold selection, return-period computation, both annual-maxima and peaks-over-threshold (POT) approaches, diagnostic plots and visualisation. For RIAA: modelling of catastrophe and extreme losses — frequency-severity-return-period analysis of floods/storms/heatwaves (concept: [[extreme-value-theory]], applications: [[extremeloss]]); complements [[extremes]] (the R standard); on the R side see the extreme-value copula families in [[copula-r]].
entries.body_hk: pyextremes（mhostetter/pyextremes，Python 2.5.0）是極值分析（Extreme Value Analysis, EVA）庫：廣義極值（GEV）與廣義帕累托（GPD）分佈擬合（含閾值選擇）、重現期計算、年最大/峰值超閾值（POT）兩種方法、診斷圖與可視化。對 RIAA：保險巨災與極端損失建模——洪水/風暴/熱浪等極端事件的頻率-強度-重現期（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 應用）；與 [[extremes]]（R 側標準庫）互補，R 側見 [[copula-r]] 的極值 copula 族。

entries.title: Burning Cost Examples
entries.summary: burning-cost 生态官方端到端示例（Colab 免安装）：DML 因果/Conformal/公平性/漂移监测实战
entries.body: burning-cost-examples（burning-cost 官方）是 burning-cost 精算库生态的端到端示例仓库：每个 notebook 自包含（装依赖+生成合成数据+拟合模型+对标标准精算方法），提供 Colab 免安装版（30 分钟总览：DML 因果效应、conformal 区间、漂移监测；快速上手：费率变更评估 DiD/ITS、代理歧视审计、校准漂移）与 Databricks 原生版（5000 保单车险组合跑通保险因果/Conformal/监测三大旗舰库）。对 RIAA：精算数据科学全家桶的零门槛实战入口——配合 [[course]]（免费 12 模块课程）与 [[insurance-causal]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 各库；对标 [[ads-tutorials]]（Wüthrich 教程）。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：官方端到端示例（Colab 免安装+Databricks），2026-03 活跃
entries.summary_en: Official end-to-end examples for the burning-cost ecosystem (Colab, zero setup): DML causality / conformal / fairness / drift monitoring in practice
entries.summary_hk: burning-cost 生態官方端到端示例（Colab 免安裝）：DML 因果/Conformal/公平性/漂移監測實戰
entries.body_en: burning-cost-examples (official, burning-cost org) is the end-to-end examples repository for the burning-cost actuarial library ecosystem: every notebook is self-contained (installs dependencies, generates synthetic data, fits models, benchmarks against standard actuarial approaches), and offers Colab zero-setup versions (a 30-minute overview: DML causal effects, conformal intervals, drift monitoring; a quickstart: rate-change evaluation with DiD/ITS, proxy-discrimination audits, calibration drift) plus a Databricks-native starter (a 5,000-policy motor portfolio running through the three flagship libraries — insurance-causal / insurance-conformal / insurance-monitoring). For RIAA: a zero-friction hands-on entry point to the actuarial data-science toolbox — pairs with [[course]] (the free 12-module course) and the libraries [[insurance-causal]], [[insurance-conformal]], [[insurance-monitoring]], [[insurance-fairness]]; comparable to [[ads-tutorials]] (the Wüthrich tutorials).
entries.body_hk: burning-cost-examples（burning-cost 官方）是 burning-cost 精算庫生態的端到端示例倉庫：每個 notebook 自包含（裝依賴+生成合成數據+擬合模型+對標標準精算方法），提供 Colab 免安裝版（30 分鐘總覽：DML 因果效應、conformal 區間、漂移監測；快速上手：費率變更評估 DiD/ITS、代理歧視審計、校準漂移）與 Databricks 原生版（5000 保單車險組合跑通保險因果/Conformal/監測三大旗艦庫）。對 RIAA：精算數據科學全家桶的零門檻實戰入口——配合 [[course]]（免費 12 模組課程）與 [[insurance-causal]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 各庫；對標 [[ads-tutorials]]（Wüthrich 教程）。

entries.title: statmod (R)
entries.summary: 统计建模 R 包（CRAN）：Tweedie GLM 分布族引擎——保险定价 GLM 的标准组件
entries.body: statmod（R CRAN 标准包）提供统计建模核心组件，其中最重要的是 Tweedie 分布族函数（tweedie 族 + 方差幂指数 p 的估计）——R 中 `glm(family=tweedie)` 定价模型的引擎。对 RIAA：Tweedie 定价 GLM 的基础设施（车险/健康险索赔频率×强度模型，见 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 与 [[tweedie]] 配套包）；另含逆高斯等分布与 GLM 诊断工具；与 [[insurance-gam]]（可解释 GAM 定价）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（GAMLSS 定价）同属 R 定价工具链。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：统计建模包（Tweedie 族，GLM 定价引擎）
entries.summary_en: Statistical-modelling R package (CRAN): the Tweedie GLM family engine — a standard component of insurance-pricing GLMs
entries.summary_hk: 統計建模 R 包（CRAN）：Tweedie GLM 分佈族引擎——保險定價 GLM 的標準組件
entries.body_en: statmod (the standard R CRAN package) provides core statistical-modelling components, most importantly the Tweedie distribution family (the tweedie family plus variance-power p estimation) — the engine behind `glm(family=tweedie)` pricing models in R. For RIAA: the infrastructure of Tweedie pricing GLMs (motor/health claim frequency×severity models, see [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] and the companion package [[tweedie]]); also includes inverse-Gaussian and other distributions plus GLM diagnostics; part of the R pricing toolchain with [[insurance-gam]] (interpretable GAM pricing) and [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (GAMLSS pricing).
entries.body_hk: statmod（R CRAN 標準套件）提供統計建模核心組件，其中最重要的是 Tweedie 分佈族函數（tweedie 族 + 方差冪指數 p 的估計）——R 中 `glm(family=tweedie)` 定價模型的引擎。對 RIAA：Tweedie 定價 GLM 的基礎設施（車險/健康險索賠頻率×強度模型，見 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 與 [[tweedie]] 配套套件）；另含逆高斯等分佈與 GLM 診斷工具；與 [[insurance-gam]]（可解釋 GAM 定價）、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]（GAMLSS 定價）同屬 R 定價工具鏈。

entries.title: gamboostLSS (R)
entries.summary: GAMLSS 提升方法 R 包（CRAN）：分布回归（均值+尺度+形状参数）的组件式提升拟合
entries.body: gamboostLSS（R CRAN，GAMLSS 的 boosting 实现）用组件式梯度提升拟合分布回归模型：同时建模响应的多个分布参数（如 Tweedie/伽马的均值、离散度、形状），自动变量选择与正则化。对 RIAA：保险定价的分布级建模（均值-离散度双模型，见 [[insurance-distributional-glm]] 的 boosting 版）——处理索赔严重度的异方差与厚尾；与 [[insurance-gam]]（可解释 GAM）、[[statmod]]（Tweedie 族）同属 R 定价工具箱；提升框架与 [[insurance-distill]]（GBM 蒸馏）思路互补。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：GAMLSS boosting 方法（分布回归多参数建模）
entries.summary_en: Boosting methods for GAMLSS (R CRAN): component-wise boosting of distributional regression (mean + scale + shape parameters)
entries.summary_hk: GAMLSS 提升方法 R 包（CRAN）：分佈回歸（均值+尺度+形狀參數）的組件式提升擬合
entries.body_en: gamboostLSS (R CRAN, the boosting implementation of GAMLSS) fits distributional regression with component-wise gradient boosting: several distribution parameters of the response are modelled simultaneously (e.g. mean, dispersion and shape of a Tweedie/gamma), with automatic variable selection and regularisation. For RIAA: distribution-level pricing (mean-dispersion double models, the boosting version of [[insurance-distributional-glm]]) — handling heteroscedasticity and heavy tails in claim severity; with [[insurance-gam]] (interpretable GAM) and [[statmod]] (Tweedie family) it forms the R pricing toolbox; the boosting idea complements [[insurance-distill]] (GBM distillation).
entries.body_hk: gamboostLSS（R CRAN，GAMLSS 的 boosting 實現）用組件式梯度提升擬合分佈回歸模型：同時建模響應的多個分佈參數（如 Tweedie/伽馬的均值、離散度、形狀），自動變量選擇與正則化。對 RIAA：保險定價的分佈級建模（均值-離散度雙模型，見 [[insurance-distributional-glm]] 的 boosting 版）——處理索賠嚴重度的異方差與厚尾；與 [[insurance-gam]]（可解釋 GAM）、[[statmod]]（Tweedie 族）同屬 R 定價工具箱；提升框架與 [[insurance-distill]]（GBM 蒸餾）思路互補。

entries.title: cvar (R)
entries.summary: VaR/ES 计算 R 包（CRAN）：连续分布的期望短缺与风险价值计算
entries.body: cvar（R CRAN）为连续分布计算期望短缺（Expected Shortfall, ES/CVaR）与风险价值（Value at Risk, VaR）：给定分布对象（如正态/伽马/自定义）直接求尾部风险度量，含多种分布支持与函数接口。对 RIAA：风险度量计算的轻量工具——[[value-at-risk]]（概念）与 ES 的数值计算，用于准备金/资本建模（Solvency II 99.5% VaR 与 ES 对比）；与 [[ggsolvencyii]]（SCR 可视化）、[[insurance-evt]]（极值索赔）配套。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：连续分布 VaR/ES 计算包
entries.summary_en: VaR/ES computation R package (CRAN): expected shortfall and value at risk for continuous distributions
entries.summary_hk: VaR/ES 計算 R 包（CRAN）：連續分佈的期望短缺與風險價值計算
entries.body_en: cvar (R CRAN) computes Expected Shortfall (ES/CVaR) and Value at Risk (VaR) for continuous distributions: given a distribution object (normal, gamma, custom, etc.) it returns the tail risk measure directly, with support for many distributions and functional interfaces. For RIAA: a lightweight tool for risk-measure computation — numerical evaluation of [[value-at-risk]] (the concept) and ES for reserving/capital modelling (Solvency II's 99.5% VaR vs ES); pairs with [[ggsolvencyii]] (SCR visualisation) and [[insurance-evt]] (extreme claims).
entries.body_hk: cvar（R CRAN）為連續分佈計算期望短缺（Expected Shortfall, ES/CVaR）與風險價值（Value at Risk, VaR）：給定分佈對象（如正態/伽馬/自定義）直接求尾部風險度量，含多種分佈支持與函數接口。對 RIAA：風險度量計算的輕量工具——[[value-at-risk]]（概念）與 ES 的數值計算，用於準備金/資本建模（Solvency II 99.5% VaR 與 ES 對比）；與 [[ggsolvencyii]]（SCR 可視化）、[[insurance-evt]]（極值索賠）配套。

entries.title: Renext (R)
entries.summary: 再保险极值外推 R 包（CRAN）：GPD/泊松过程拟合、再保层定价与极端事件重现
entries.body: Renext（R CRAN）用更新方法（renewal method）做极值外推：拟合广义帕累托（GPD）与泊松/更新过程模型，用于再保险定价——超额损失再保层（XL）的定价、极端事件重现期与尾部概率，支持保险业常用数据格式（含阈值与删失数据）。对 RIAA：再保险与极端损失定价的专业工具——与 [[reinsurance]]（概念）、[[extremeloss]]（极端损失）、[[insurance-evt]]（极值索赔 EVT）配套；R 侧极值族另见 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：再保险极值外推（GPD+更新过程，XL 再保定价）
entries.summary_en: Reinsurance extreme-value extrapolation R package (CRAN): GPD/Poisson-process fitting, excess-of-loss layer pricing and extreme-event return periods
entries.summary_hk: 再保險極值外推 R 包（CRAN）：GPD/泊松過程擬合、再保層定價與極端事件重現
entries.body_en: Renext (R CRAN) performs extreme-value extrapolation with the renewal method: it fits generalised Pareto (GPD) and Poisson/renewal-process models for reinsurance pricing — excess-of-loss (XL) layer pricing, return periods and tail probabilities of extreme events — and supports insurance-style data formats (with thresholds and censored data). For RIAA: a specialised tool for reinsurance and extreme-loss pricing — pairs with [[reinsurance]] (the concept), [[extremeloss]] (extreme losses) and [[insurance-evt]] (EVT for claims); other members of the R extreme-value family: [[evir]], [[mev]], [[extremes]].
entries.body_hk: Renext（R CRAN）用更新方法（renewal method）做極值外推：擬合廣義帕累托（GPD）與泊松/更新過程模型，用於再保險定價——超額損失再保層（XL）的定價、極端事件重現期與尾部概率，支持保險業常用數據格式（含閾值與刪失數據）。對 RIAA：再保險與極端損失定價的專業工具——與 [[reinsurance]]（概念）、[[extremeloss]]（極端損失）、[[insurance-evt]]（極值索賠 EVT）配套；R 側極值族另見 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。

entries.title: fitHeavyTail (R)
entries.summary: 重尾均值-协方差估计 R 包（CRAN）：厚尾数据下的稳健矩估计（金融/保险风险因子）
entries.body: fitHeavyTail（R CRAN）在重尾（heavy-tailed）数据下估计均值与协方差矩阵：对厚尾分布（t、更一般椭圆分布）做稳健的矩估计与收缩，避免经典估计被极端观测支配——金融与保险风险因子的标准场景（资产收益、索赔严重度）。对 RIAA：厚尾风险因子的稳健统计——与 [[insurance-evt]]（极值索赔）、[[pyextremes]]（Python EVA）、[[cvar-r]]（尾部风险度量）配套；组合风险视角衔接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 与相关矩阵工具。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：重尾下均值/协方差估计包
entries.summary_en: Heavy-tailed mean-covariance estimation R package (CRAN): robust moment estimation under heavy tails (finance/insurance risk factors)
entries.summary_hk: 重尾均值-協方差估計 R 包（CRAN）：厚尾數據下的穩健矩估計（金融/保險風險因子）
entries.body_en: fitHeavyTail (R CRAN) estimates means and covariance matrices under heavy-tailed data: robust moment estimation and shrinkage for thick-tailed distributions (t and more general elliptical), avoiding classical estimates being dominated by extreme observations — the standard setting for financial and insurance risk factors (asset returns, claim severity). For RIAA: robust statistics for heavy-tailed risk factors — pairs with [[insurance-evt]] (extreme claims), [[pyextremes]] (Python EVA) and [[cvar-r]] (tail risk measures); the portfolio angle connects to [[concentrationmetrics]] and correlation-matrix tooling.
entries.body_hk: fitHeavyTail（R CRAN）在重尾（heavy-tailed）數據下估計均值與協方差矩陣：對厚尾分佈（t、更一般橢圓分佈）做穩健的矩估計與收縮，避免經典估計被極端觀測支配——金融與保險風險因子的標準場景（資產收益、索賠嚴重度）。對 RIAA：厚尾風險因子的穩健統計——與 [[insurance-evt]]（極值索賠）、[[pyextremes]]（Python EVA）、[[cvar-r]]（尾部風險度量）配套；組合風險視角銜接 [[concentrationmetrics]] 與相關矩陣工具。

entries.title: Parsr (AXA)
entries.summary: AXA 开源文档解析管线（6178★）：PDF/图片 → 结构化数据（文本/表格/层级），文档提取标配
entries.body: Parsr（axa-group/Parsr，6178★，MIT）是 AXA 开源的多语言文档解析管线：「Turn your documents into data」——把 PDF/文档/图片转为结构化数据（文本、表格、层级结构、标签），可自定义处理链（去噪、OCR、表识别、结构重建）。对 RIAA：保险文档处理的基础设施——理赔文件/保单文档/监管文件的自动化提取（配合 [[mineru]]（PDF→markdown）、MCP 类理赔文档工具如 [[claims-intake-agent]]）；与 AI 保险文档 RAG 场景衔接。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：AXA 官方文档解析管线（PDF/图片→结构化数据），6178★
entries.summary_en: AXA's open-source document-parsing pipeline (6178★): PDF/images → structured data (text/tables/hierarchy) — the standard for document extraction
entries.summary_hk: AXA 開源文檔解析管線（6178★）：PDF/圖片 → 結構化數據（文本/表格/層級），文檔提取標配
entries.body_en: Parsr (axa-group/Parsr, 6178★, MIT) is AXA's open-source multilingual document-parsing pipeline: "Turn your documents into data" — it converts PDFs/documents/images into structured data (text, tables, hierarchy, labels) through a customisable processing chain (denoising, OCR, table detection, structure reconstruction). For RIAA: infrastructure for insurance document processing — automated extraction from claim files / policy documents / regulatory filings (alongside [[mineru]] (PDF→markdown) and MCP-style claims-document tools such as [[claims-intake-agent]]); connects to insurance-document RAG scenarios.
entries.body_hk: Parsr（axa-group/Parsr，6178★，MIT）是 AXA 開源的多語言文檔解析管線：「Turn your documents into data」——把 PDF/文檔/圖片轉為結構化數據（文本、表格、層級結構、標籤），可自定義處理鏈（去噪、OCR、表識別、結構重建）。對 RIAA：保險文檔處理的基礎設施——理賠文件/保單文檔/監管文件的自動化提取（配合 [[mineru]]（PDF→markdown）、MCP 類理賠文檔工具如 [[claims-intake-agent]]）；與 AI 保險文檔 RAG 場景銜接。

entries.title: nlp.js (AXA)
entries.summary: AXA 开源 NLP 对话库（6587★）：多语言意图识别/实体抽取/聊天机器人构建框架
entries.body: nlp.js（axa-group/nlp.js，6587★，MIT）是 AXA 开源的 Node.js NLP 库：构建聊天机器人/对话助手的完整框架——意图识别（分类）、实体抽取、多语言支持（数十种语言）、词干化与相似度匹配，可接多种 NLU 引擎。对 RIAA：保险客服/理赔对话助手的前端 NLU 方案——大厂（AXA）开源旗舰；与 [[parsr]]（同组织文档解析）配套构成保险 AI 文档+对话组合；对比 [[insurance-llm-framework]]（LLM 路线）理解传统 NLU vs LLM 的取舍。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：AXA 官方 NLP 库（意图识别/实体抽取/多语言），6587★
entries.summary_en: AXA's open-source NLP library (6587★): multilingual intent recognition / entity extraction / chatbot-building framework
entries.summary_hk: AXA 開源 NLP 對話庫（6587★）：多語言意圖識別/實體抽取/聊天機器人構建框架
entries.body_en: nlp.js (axa-group/nlp.js, 6587★, MIT) is AXA's open-source Node.js NLP library: a complete framework for building chatbots/conversational assistants — intent recognition (classification), entity extraction, multilingual support (dozens of languages), stemming and similarity matching, with pluggable NLU engines. For RIAA: a front-end NLU solution for insurance customer-service/claims conversational assistants — a flagship open source from a major insurer; pairs with [[parsr]] (sister document-parsing project from the same org) for an insurance AI document+conversation combo; compare with [[insurance-llm-framework]] (the LLM route) to understand the traditional-NLU vs LLM trade-off.
entries.body_hk: nlp.js（axa-group/nlp.js，6587★，MIT）是 AXA 開源的 Node.js NLP 庫：構建聊天機器人/對話助手的完整框架——意圖識別（分類）、實體抽取、多語言支持（數十種語言）、詞幹化與相似度匹配，可接多種 NLU 引擎。對 RIAA：保險客服/理賠對話助手的前端 NLU 方案——大廠（AXA）開源旗艦；與 [[parsr]]（同組織文檔解析）配套構成保險 AI 文檔+對話組合；對比 [[insurance-llm-framework]]（LLM 路線）理解傳統 NLU vs LLM 的取捨。

entries.title: ismev (R)
entries.summary: 极值统计建模经典 R 包（CRAN，Coles 教材配套）：GEV/GPD 拟合与诊断
entries.body: ismev（R CRAN）是极值统计建模的经典 R 包，配套 Coles《An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values》：广义极值（GEV）与广义帕累托（GPD）模型拟合、阈值选择、重现水平、诊断图（QQ/残差）等。对 RIAA：极值理论的教科书级实现——巨灾/极端损失建模（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 应用）的标准起点；与 [[extremes]]、[[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[eva]]（R 侧极值族）、[[pyextremes]]（Python 侧）、[[renext]]（再保极值）互补；配 [[insurance-evt]]（保险索赔 EVT）。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：Coles 极值统计教材配套包（GEV/GPD/诊断）
entries.summary_en: Classic R package for extreme-value statistical modelling (CRAN, companion to Coles' textbook): GEV/GPD fitting and diagnostics
entries.summary_hk: 極值統計建模經典 R 包（CRAN，Coles 教材配套）：GEV/GPD 擬合與診斷
entries.body_en: ismev (R CRAN) is the classic R package for extreme-value statistical modelling, companion to Coles' "An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values": generalised extreme value (GEV) and generalised Pareto (GPD) fitting, threshold selection, return levels and diagnostic plots (QQ/residuals). For RIAA: a textbook-grade implementation of extreme-value theory — the standard starting point for catastrophe/extreme-loss modelling (concept: [[extreme-value-theory]], applications: [[extremeloss]]); complements [[extremes]], [[evir]], [[mev]] and [[eva]] (the R extreme-value family), [[pyextremes]] (Python side) and [[renext]] (reinsurance extremes); pairs with [[insurance-evt]] (EVT for insurance claims).
entries.body_hk: ismev（R CRAN）是極值統計建模的經典 R 套件，配套 Coles《An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values》：廣義極值（GEV）與廣義帕累托（GPD）模型擬合、閾值選擇、重現水平、診斷圖（QQ/殘差）等。對 RIAA：極值理論的教科書級實現——巨災/極端損失建模（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 應用）的標準起點；與 [[extremes]]、[[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[eva]]（R 側極值族）、[[pyextremes]]（Python 側）、[[renext]]（再保極值）互補；配 [[insurance-evt]]（保險索賠 EVT）。

entries.title: eva (R)
entries.summary: 极值分析+拟合优度检验 R 包（CRAN）：GEV/GPD 估计与假设检验
entries.body: eva（R CRAN）是极值分析（EVA）R 包，特色是拟合优度检验（goodness-of-fit testing）：GEV 与 GPD 分布的参数估计（MLE）、假设检验、重现水平与尾部概率计算。对 RIAA：极值建模的假设检验工具——在 [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] 等拟合基础上做模型诊断与比较（[[extreme-value-theory]]）；与 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[pyextremes]] 同族；保险场景见 [[insurance-evt]]、[[extremeloss]]。
entries.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：极值分析+拟合优度检验包
entries.summary_en: Extreme Value Analysis with goodness-of-fit testing (R CRAN): GEV/GPD estimation and hypothesis testing
entries.summary_hk: 極值分析+擬合優度檢驗 R 包（CRAN）：GEV/GPD 估計與假設檢驗
entries.body_en: eva (R CRAN) is an Extreme Value Analysis (EVA) R package whose distinctive feature is goodness-of-fit testing: parameter estimation (MLE) of GEV and GPD distributions, hypothesis tests, return levels and tail probabilities. For RIAA: a hypothesis-testing tool for extreme-value modelling — model diagnostics and comparison on top of fitting from [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] ([[extreme-value-theory]]); same family as [[evir]], [[mev]] and [[pyextremes]]; insurance applications: [[insurance-evt]], [[extremeloss]].
entries.body_hk: eva（R CRAN）是極值分析（EVA）R 套件，特色是擬合優度檢驗（goodness-of-fit testing）：GEV 與 GPD 分佈的參數估計（MLE）、假設檢驗、重現水平與尾部概率計算。對 RIAA：極值建模的假設檢驗工具——在 [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] 等擬合基礎上做模型診斷與比較（[[extreme-value-theory]]）；與 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[pyextremes]] 同族；保險場景見 [[insurance-evt]]、[[extremeloss]]。

entries.title: Physrisk (OS-Climate)
entries.summary: 物理气候风险计算引擎（OS-Climate/FINOS，67★）：洪水/热浪/飓风等的组合级气候风险评估
entries.body: Physrisk（os-climate/physrisk，67★，Apache-2.0）是 OS-Climate 项目（2024 年并入 FINOS 治理）的物理气候风险计算引擎：评估气候变化物理效应（洪水、热浪、飓风、野火等）对资产/组合的潜在影响，输出分情景/分时期的风险评分，配套数据管道与 Web UI（physrisk-ui）。对 RIAA：投资组合与承保组合的气候物理风险量化——与 [[climada]]（ETH 气候风险）、[[openquake-engine]]（地震风险）、[[catia]]（巨灾 AI）同属巨灾气候生态；关联 [[databricks-flood-prediction]]（洪水预测方案）。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：OS-Climate/FINOS 物理气候风险引擎（67★，PyPI physrisk-lib）
entries.summary_en: Physical climate risk calculation engine (OS-Climate/FINOS, 67★): portfolio-level climate risk assessment for flood/heatwave/hurricane etc.
entries.summary_hk: 物理氣候風險計算引擎（OS-Climate/FINOS，67★）：洪水/熱浪/颶風等的組合級氣候風險評估
entries.body_en: Physrisk (os-climate/physrisk, 67★, Apache-2.0) is the OS-Climate project's (transitioned to FINOS governance in 2024) physical climate risk calculation engine: it assesses the potential impact of climate-change physical effects (flood, heatwave, hurricane, wildfire, etc.) on assets/portfolios, producing scenario- and period-based risk scores, with companion data pipelines and a web UI (physrisk-ui). For RIAA: quantifying physical climate risk for investment and underwriting portfolios — alongside [[climada]] (ETH climate risk), [[openquake-engine]] (seismic risk) and [[catia]] (catastrophe AI) in the catastrophe/climate ecosystem; related: [[databricks-flood-prediction]] (flood prediction solution).
entries.body_hk: Physrisk（os-climate/physrisk，67★，Apache-2.0）是 OS-Climate 項目（2024 年併入 FINOS 治理）的物理氣候風險計算引擎：評估氣候變化物理效應（洪水、熱浪、颶風、野火等）對資產/組合的潛在影響，輸出分情景/分時期的風險評分，配套數據管道與 Web UI（physrisk-ui）。對 RIAA：投資組合與承保組合的氣候物理風險量化——與 [[climada]]（ETH 氣候風險）、[[openquake-engine]]（地震風險）、[[catia]]（巨災 AI）同屬巨災氣候生態；關聯 [[databricks-flood-prediction]]（洪水預測方案）。

entries.title: RAG_Insurance (Qwen)
entries.summary: 中文保险 RAG 业务链（12★）：保险 QA+合同条款检索，Qwen 大模型+意图识别+稠密稀疏混合索引
entries.body: RAG_Insurance（lyxx3rd/RAG_Insurance，12★）是基于保险 QA 与合同条款的中文 RAG 业务链：以 Qwen API 为语言模型，含分类算法（意图识别）训练、RAG embedding 模型微调、稠密+稀疏索引的建立与混合检索（Hybrid Search）。对 RIAA：中文保险场景 RAG 的完整落地范例——意图分类→条款检索→生成回答的业务链（属 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 一类文档问答场景）；与 [[insurance-llm-framework]]（LLM 实验框架）、中文金融模型生态同属中文 AI 保险生态。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：中文保险 QA+条款 RAG 业务链（Qwen+意图识别+稠密稀疏混合检索），12★

entries.summary_hk: 中文保險 RAG 業務鏈（12★）：保險 QA+合同條款檢索，Qwen 大模型+意圖識別+稠密稀疏混合索引
entries.body_en: RAG_Insurance (lyxx3rd/RAG_Insurance, 12★) is a Chinese-language insurance RAG pipeline built on insurance QA and contract clauses: it uses the Qwen API as the LLM and includes intent-classification training, RAG embedding-model fine-tuning, and hybrid dense+sparse indexing and retrieval (Hybrid Search). For RIAA: a complete Chinese-insurance RAG implementation example — an intent-classify → clause-retrieve → answer-generate business chain (the document-QA family of [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]); with [[insurance-llm-framework]] (an LLM experiment framework) and the Chinese financial-model ecosystem it represents the Chinese AI-insurance stack.
entries.body_hk: RAG_Insurance（lyxx3rd/RAG_Insurance，12★）是基於保險 QA 與合同條款的中文 RAG 業務鏈：以 Qwen API 為語言模型，含分類算法（意圖識別）訓練、RAG embedding 模型微調、稠密+稀疏索引的建立與混合檢索（Hybrid Search）。對 RIAA：中文保險場景 RAG 的完整落地範例——意圖分類→條款檢索→生成回答的業務鏈（屬 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 一類文檔問答場景）；與 [[insurance-llm-framework]]（LLM 實驗框架）、中文金融模型生態同屬中文 AI 保險棧。

entries.title: HurricaneGuard (Etherisc)
entries.summary: 区块链参数化飓风保险合约（16★，Etherisc）：以太坊智能合约+NOAA 气象参数自动赔付
entries.body: HurricaneGuard（etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard，16★）是 Etherisc 团队构建的首个区块链参数化飓风保险：以太坊智能合约 + NOAA 验证气象参数，飓风事件触发后数日内自动赔付——覆盖房屋损失、营业损失与收入损失，保单条款公开、合规许可、支持加密货币支付。对 RIAA：参数化保险（[[parametric-insurance]]）的区块链实现案例——智能合约自动执行理赔（与 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 等参数化巨灾债券同思路）；保险科技前沿方向（去中心化保险）；另见 Chainlink 博客的同类作物参数险 demo。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：Etherisc 参数化飓风保险智能合约（NOAA 参数触发自动赔付），16★
entries.summary_en: Blockchain parametric hurricane insurance contracts (16★, Etherisc): Ethereum smart contracts + NOAA weather parameters with automatic payout
entries.summary_hk: 區塊鏈參數化颶風保險合約（16★，Etherisc）：以太坊智能合約+NOAA 氣象參數自動賠付
entries.body_en: HurricaneGuard (etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard, 16★) is the first blockchain-powered parametric hurricane insurance built by the Etherisc team: Ethereum smart contracts + NOAA-validated weather parameters trigger automatic payouts within days of a hurricane event — covering property damage, business losses and loss of income, with public policy terms, licensed coverage and cryptocurrency payment options. For RIAA: a blockchain implementation case of parametric insurance ([[parametric-insurance]]) — smart contracts automating claim settlement (the same idea as parametric catastrophe bonds such as [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]); an insurtech frontier direction (decentralised insurance); see also the Chainlink-blog crop parametric demo of the same kind.
entries.body_hk: HurricaneGuard（etherisc-legacy/HurricaneGuard，16★）是 Etherisc 團隊構建的首個區塊鏈參數化颶風保險：以太坊智能合約 + NOAA 驗證氣象參數，颶風事件觸發後數日內自動賠付——覆蓋房屋損失、營業損失與收入損失，保單條款公開、合規許可、支持加密貨幣支付。對 RIAA：參數化保險（[[parametric-insurance]]）的區塊鏈實現案例——智能合約自動執行理賠（與 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 等參數化巨災債券同思路）；保險科技前沿方向（去中心化保險）；另見 Chainlink 博客的同類作物參數險 demo。

entries.title: AWS Serverless Claims EDA
entries.summary: AWS 官方无服务器理赔事件驱动架构样例（64★）：Kinesis/Lambda 流式理赔处理参考架构
entries.body: serverless-eda-insurance-claims-processing（aws-samples，64★）是 AWS 官方样例：无服务器（serverless）事件驱动架构（EDA）的保险理赔处理——流式摄取（Kinesis）、Lambda 处理、状态机编排的事件驱动参考实现。对 RIAA：理赔处理的生产级架构模式（事件驱动 vs 传统批处理）——与 [[claims-intake-agent]]（AI 受理）、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]（微软自动化加速器）对照厂商架构风格；事件驱动设计对实时理赔/欺诈监测（[[claims-triage-mcp]]）有直接启发。

entries.summary_hk: AWS 官方無伺服器理賠事件驅動架構樣例（64★）：Kinesis/Lambda 流式理賠處理參考架構
entries.body_en: serverless-eda-insurance-claims-processing (aws-samples, 64★) is an AWS official sample: a serverless, event-driven architecture (EDA) for insurance claims processing — streaming ingestion (Kinesis), Lambda processing and state-machine orchestration in an event-driven reference implementation. For RIAA: a production-grade architecture pattern for claims processing (event-driven vs traditional batch) — compare vendor architecture styles with [[claims-intake-agent]] (AI intake) and [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]] (Microsoft automation accelerator); event-driven design is directly instructive for real-time claims/fraud monitoring ([[claims-triage-mcp]]).
entries.body_hk: serverless-eda-insurance-claims-processing（aws-samples，64★）是 AWS 官方樣例：無伺服器（serverless）事件驅動架構（EDA）的保險理賠處理——流式攝取（Kinesis）、Lambda 處理、狀態機編排的事件驅動參考實現。對 RIAA：理賠處理的生產級架構模式（事件驅動 vs 傳統批處理）——與 [[claims-intake-agent]]（AI 受理）、[[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]（微軟自動化加速器）對照廠商架構風格；事件驅動設計對實時理賠/欺詐監測（[[claims-triage-mcp]]）有直接啟發。

entries.title: IFRS Skill
entries.summary: IFRS/IAS 引用式 AI skill（15★，MIT）：Claude Code/Codex 等助手接入，带段落引用的准则问答
entries.body: IFRS Skill（ramyatrouny/ifrs-skill，15★，MIT）是带引用的 IFRS/IAS 参考 skill：接入 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 或 Cursor 后，用自然语言提问即可得到附段落引用（paragraph reference）的准则答案，便于对照准则原文核验——面向财务报告团队、审计师与其开发者。对 RIAA：IFRS 会计知识的 AI 助手接入（IFRS 17/9 相关查询）——与 [[actuarial-skills]]（P&C 精算 skills）同类；配套 [[ifrs17a]]（计量库）、[[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]]（计算引擎）、[[ifrs9-ecl]]（减值模型）；注意 skill 输出需对照准则原文核验。

For RIAA: IFRS-knowledge access for AI assistants (IFRS 17/9 queries) — the same family as [[actuarial-skills]] (P&C actuarial skills); pairs with [[ifrs17a]] (measurement library), [[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]] (calculation engine) and [[ifrs9-ecl]] (impairment); note that the skill's output must be verified against the standard before reliance.

entries.title: raw (CAS R 数据包)

entries.body: raw（casact/raw_package，CRAN 包，12★）是 CAS（北美产险精算学会）官方为 R 精算教学准备的数据包：整理多组对非寿险精算师有用的公开数据集，建议一套执业精算师常用包清单（`raw::InstallSuggestions()` 一键安装），并提供基本准备金分析的 R Markdown 骨架。对 RIAA：非寿险 R 教学/自学的官方数据与起步模板——与 [[casdatasets]]（CAS 数据集目录）、[[chainladder]]（准备金库）、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]（定价实战）配套；适合课堂/工作坊场景。

entries.summary: 中文保险条款 PDF 重排指令集（HF，9 likes）：天池公共数据清洗，Alpaca 格式条款可读化
entries.body: chinese_insurance_doc_parsing（kaihe，HF 9 likes）是中文保险条款文档解析指令数据集：从天池实验室公共数据集清洗，结合原标注与 PDF 解析工具构造 Alpaca 格式数据——输入 PDF 直接提取的乱版条款字符串（如太平洋人寿税延养老险条款），指令为重新组织成清晰可读格式（公司名/产品名/章节层级/空行规范）。对 RIAA：中文保险条款解析 LLM 的微调/评测数据——与 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（中文保险语料）、[[kgqa-insurance-product]]（产品知识图谱）同属中文生态；条款重排任务配合 [[mineru]]（PDF→markdown）理解文档解析全链。

entries.body_en: chinese_insurance_doc_parsing (kaihe, HF 9 likes) is an instruction dataset for Chinese insurance-policy document parsing: cleaned from the Tiangchi-lab public dataset and built with original annotations plus PDF-parsing tools into Alpaca format — the input is a raw PDF-extracted, layout-mangled policy-text string (e.g. Pacific Life tax-deferred pension clauses), and the instruction is to reorganise it into a clear, readable layout (company name / product name / numbered sections / blank-line rules). For RIAA: fine-tuning/evaluation data for Chinese policy-clause parsing LLMs — with [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (Chinese insurance corpus) and [[kgqa-insurance-product]] (product knowledge graph) it forms the Chinese ecosystem; pair the restructuring task with [[mineru]] (PDF→markdown) to understand the full document-parsing chain.

entries.title: DemoKin (R)
entries.summary: 亲属关系分布估计 R 包（28★）：按类型与年龄估计 kinship 分布（人口投影/家庭人口学）
entries.body: DemoKin（IvanWilli/DemoKin，28★）估计亲属关系（kinship）分布：按亲属类型与年龄给出人口中各类亲属的数量与分布，支持生育/死亡/迁移率输入，用于家庭人口学（household/family demography）与人口投影研究。对 RIAA：长寿与家庭人口学的进阶工具——亲属网络估计在养老金/长期护理（LTC）研究的场景化应用；与 [[demography]]（人口预测）、[[mortalitylaws]]（死亡率模型）、[[lifecon]]（寿险精算讲义）配套；关联 [[longevity]]、[[longevity-risk]]。

entries.body_en: DemoKin (IvanWilli/DemoKin, 28★) estimates kinship distributions: the number and distribution of each kin type by age in a population, given fertility/mortality/migration rates — used in family demography and population-projection research. For RIAA: an advanced tool for longevity and family demography — kinship-network estimation finds scenario applications in pension and long-term-care (LTC) research; pairs with [[demography]] (population projection), [[mortalitylaws]] (mortality models) and [[lifecon]] (life actuarial lecture notes); related: [[longevity]], [[longevity-risk]].

entries.title: Copulas.jl
entries.summary: Julia copula 库（116★，Distributions.jl 兼容）：椭圆/阿基米德/藤 copula 统一接口
entries.body: Copulas.jl（lrnv/Copulas.jl，116★）是 Julia 的 copula 库：完全兼容 Distributions.jl 生态——椭圆（Gaussian/t）、阿基米德（Clayton/Gumbel/Frank）与藤（vine）copula 的统一分布接口（采样/PDF/CDF/拟合）。对 RIAA：Julia 侧的相依建模——与 [[copula-r]]（R 标准）、[[pyvinecopulib]]/[[torchvinecopulib]]（Python 藤）构成跨语言 copula 家族；配合 [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]] 等 JuliaActuary 生态使用。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：Distributions.jl 兼容的 Julia copula 包（椭圆/阿基米德/藤），116★
entries.summary_en: Julia copula package (116★, Distributions.jl-compliant): unified interface for elliptical/Archimedean/vine copulas
entries.summary_hk: Julia copula 庫（116★，Distributions.jl 兼容）：橢圓/阿基米德/藤 copula 統一接口
entries.body_en: Copulas.jl (lrnv/Copulas.jl, 116★) is a Julia copula package fully compliant with the Distributions.jl ecosystem: unified distribution interfaces (sampling / PDF / CDF / fitting) for elliptical (Gaussian/t), Archimedean (Clayton/Gumbel/Frank) and vine copulas. For RIAA: dependence modelling on the Julia side — with [[copula-r]] (the R standard) and [[pyvinecopulib]]/[[torchvinecopulib]] (Python vines) it forms a cross-language copula family; use it alongside the JuliaActuary ecosystem such as [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]] and [[lifecontingencies-jl]].
entries.body_hk: Copulas.jl（lrnv/Copulas.jl，116★）是 Julia 的 copula 庫：完全兼容 Distributions.jl 生態——橢圓（Gaussian/t）、阿基米德（Clayton/Gumbel/Frank）與藤（vine）copula 的統一分佈接口（採樣/PDF/CDF/擬合）。對 RIAA：Julia 側的相依建模——與 [[copula-r]]（R 標準）、[[pyvinecopulib]]/[[torchvinecopulib]]（Python 藤）構成跨語言 copula 家族；配合 [[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]] 等 JuliaActuary 生態使用。

entries.title: torchvinecopulib
entries.summary: PyTorch 藤 copula 库（251★）：GPU 加速的 vine copula 拟合与采样
entries.body: torchvinecopulib（TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib，251★）是用 PyTorch 实现的高维 vine copula 拟合与采样库：借助 GPU/自动微分，支持大维度数据上的 C/R/D-vine 结构选择、参数估计与条件采样。对 RIAA：高维相依建模的现代（GPU）实现——巨灾多险种组合、多风险因子聚合（[[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]] 的 PyTorch 替代）；与 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia 侧）互补；配 [[concentrationmetrics]] 做分散度分析。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：PyTorch vine copula 拟合/采样库，251★
entries.summary_en: PyTorch vine-copula library (251★): GPU-accelerated vine-copula fitting and sampling
entries.summary_hk: PyTorch 藤 copula 庫（251★）：GPU 加速的 vine copula 擬合與採樣
entries.body_en: torchvinecopulib (TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib, 251★) is a library for high-dimensional vine-copula fitting and sampling built on PyTorch: leveraging GPU and automatic differentiation, it supports C/R/D-vine structure selection, parameter estimation and conditional sampling on large-dimensional data. For RIAA: a modern (GPU) implementation of high-dimensional dependence modelling — for multi-line catastrophe portfolios and multi-risk-factor aggregation (a PyTorch alternative to [[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]]); complements [[copulas-jl]] (Julia side); pair with [[concentrationmetrics]] for diversification analysis.
entries.body_hk: torchvinecopulib（TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib，251★）是用 PyTorch 實現的高維 vine copula 擬合與採樣庫：借助 GPU/自動微分，支持大維度數據上的 C/R/D-vine 結構選擇、參數估計與條件採樣。對 RIAA：高維相依建模的現代（GPU）實現——巨災多險種組合、多風險因子聚合（[[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]] 的 PyTorch 替代）；與 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia 側）互補；配 [[concentrationmetrics]] 做分散度分析。

entries.title: mixedvines (Python)
entries.summary: 混合边缘 vine copula Python 包（49★）：连续+离散边缘的规范藤建模（保险数据典型）
entries.body: mixedvines（asnelt/mixedvines，49★）是 Python 混合边缘 vine copula 包：支持连续与离散边缘混合的规范藤（canonical vine）树建模——保险/理赔数据（计数+连续混合）的典型结构。对 RIAA：混合数据类型（离散索赔次数+连续严重度）的相依建模——与 [[copula-surv]]（生存 copula）、[[insurance-copula]]（保险定价 copula）互补；Python 侧配合 [[torchvinecopulib]]（高维）、[[pycopent]]（独立性检验）。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：混合连续/离散边缘的 vine copula Python 包，49★
entries.summary_en: Mixed-marginal vine-copula Python package (49★): canonical-vine modelling with mixed continuous + discrete marginals (typical of insurance data)
entries.summary_hk: 混合邊緣 vine copula Python 包（49★）：連續+離散邊緣的規範藤建模（保險數據典型）
entries.body_en: mixedvines (asnelt/mixedvines, 49★) is a Python vine-copula package for mixed marginals: it models canonical-vine trees with a mix of continuous and discrete marginal distributions — a structure typical of insurance/claims data (discrete claim counts + continuous severities). For RIAA: dependence modelling on mixed data types — complements [[copula-surv]] (survival copulas) and [[insurance-copula]] (copulas for insurance pricing); on the Python side pair with [[torchvinecopulib]] (high-dimensional) and [[pycopent]] (independence testing).
entries.body_hk: mixedvines（asnelt/mixedvines，49★）是 Python 混合邊緣 vine copula 套件：支持連續與離散邊緣混合的規範藤（canonical vine）樹建模——保險/理賠數據（計數+連續混合）的典型結構。對 RIAA：混合數據類型（離散索賠次數+連續嚴重度）的相依建模——與 [[copula-surv]]（生存 copula）、[[insurance-copula]]（保險定價 copula）互補；Python 側配合 [[torchvinecopulib]]（高維）、[[pycopent]]（獨立性檢驗）。

entries.title: pycopent
entries.summary: Copula 熵 Python 库（172★）：互信息/传递熵估计，变量依赖与因果分析
entries.body: pycopent（majianthu/pycopent，172★）估计 Copula 熵（Copula Entropy = 负互信息）：互信息（Mutual Information）、传递熵（Transfer Entropy）、条件互信息——用于变量依赖分析、独立性检验与因果方向发现（期刊论文配套实现）。对 RIAA：风险因子依赖/因果探索的非参数工具——变量选择（定价模型）、欺诈网络变量相关性；与 [[copula-r]]（建模侧）、[[pyvinecopulib]]（结构侧）互补；独立性检验配合 [[mixedvines]] 的混合数据场景。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：Copula 熵（互信息/传递熵）估计库，172★
entries.summary_en: Copula-entropy Python library (172★): mutual information / transfer entropy estimation for dependence and causal analysis
entries.summary_hk: Copula 熵 Python 庫（172★）：互信息/傳遞熵估計，變量依賴與因果分析
entries.body_en: pycopent (majianthu/pycopent, 172★) estimates Copula Entropy (= negative mutual information): mutual information, transfer entropy and conditional mutual information — for variable-dependence analysis, independence testing and causal-direction discovery (companion implementation to journal papers). For RIAA: a non-parametric tool for risk-factor dependence/causality exploration — variable selection (in pricing models) and correlation among fraud-network variables; complements [[copula-r]] (modelling side) and [[pyvinecopulib]] (structure side); independence testing pairs with the mixed-data scenarios of [[mixedvines]].
entries.body_hk: pycopent（majianthu/pycopent，172★）估計 Copula 熵（Copula Entropy = 負互信息）：互信息（Mutual Information）、傳遞熵（Transfer Entropy）、條件互信息——用於變量依賴分析、獨立性檢驗與因果方向發現（期刊論文配套實現）。對 RIAA：風險因子依賴/因果探索的非參數工具——變量選擇（定價模型）、欺詐網絡變量相關性；與 [[copula-r]]（建模側）、[[pyvinecopulib]]（結構側）互補；獨立性檢驗配合 [[mixedvines]] 的混合數據場景。

entries.title: MAPIE
entries.summary: scikit-learn 兼容 Conformal 预测库（1585★）：预测区间估计与风险控制的标准实现
entries.body: MAPIE（scikit-learn-contrib/MAPIE，1585★，BSD）是 scikit-learn 兼容的 conformal 预测库：预测区间估计（分位数/回归/分类）、风险控制（Risk Control）、保形校准——标准机器学习模型一行接入不确定性量化。对 RIAA：模型不确定性的标准工具——与 [[insurance-conformal]]（Tweedie/Poisson 保险定价 conformal）、[[insurance-conformal-claims]]（索赔回归）、[[insurance-conformal-risk]]（预期损失保障）等 burning-cost 应用层配套；比 [[fortuna]] 更贴近 sklearn 生态。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：scikit-learn 兼容 conformal 预测库（区间估计/风险控制），1585★
entries.summary_en: scikit-learn-compatible Conformal-prediction library (1585★): the standard implementation of prediction intervals and risk control
entries.summary_hk: scikit-learn 兼容 Conformal 預測庫（1585★）：預測區間估計與風險控制的標準實現
entries.body_en: MAPIE (scikit-learn-contrib/MAPIE, 1585★, BSD) is a scikit-learn-compatible conformal-prediction library: prediction-interval estimation (quantile / regression / classification), risk control, and conformal calibration — one-line uncertainty quantification on standard ML models. For RIAA: the standard tool for model uncertainty — pairs with the burning-cost application layer such as [[insurance-conformal]] (Tweedie/Poisson insurance-pricing conformal), [[insurance-conformal-claims]] (claims regression) and [[insurance-conformal-risk]] (expected-loss guarantees); closer to the sklearn ecosystem than [[fortuna]].
entries.body_hk: MAPIE（scikit-learn-contrib/MAPIE，1585★，BSD）是 scikit-learn 兼容的 conformal 預測庫：預測區間估計（分位數/回歸/分類）、風險控制（Risk Control）、保形校準——標準機器學習模型一行接入不確定性量化。對 RIAA：模型不確定性的標準工具——與 [[insurance-conformal]]（Tweedie/Poisson 保險定價 conformal）、[[insurance-conformal-claims]]（索賠回歸）、[[insurance-conformal-risk]]（預期損失保障）等 burning-cost 應用層配套；比 [[fortuna]] 更貼近 sklearn 生態。

entries.title: Fortuna (AWS)
entries.summary: AWS 不确定性量化库（928★）：Conformal+贝叶斯深度学习的可扩展 UQ 框架
entries.body: Fortuna（awslabs/fortuna，928★，Apache-2.0）是 AWS Labs 的不确定性量化（UQ）库：统一接口下提供 conformal 预测区间、贝叶斯深度学习（变分推断/深度集成/随机投影）与校准方法，面向生产环境的可扩展 UQ。对 RIAA：模型不确定性的企业级工具（AWS 官方）——风险度量（VaR/ES）与预测区间的工程化实现；与 [[mapie]]（sklearn 生态）、[[insurance-conformal]]（保险应用）互补；AWS 生态与 [[aws-fraud-graph]]、[[aws-serverless-claims-eda]] 同类。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：AWS 官方 UQ 库（Conformal+贝叶斯 DL），928★
entries.summary_en: AWS uncertainty-quantification library (928★): scalable UQ framework with conformal + Bayesian deep learning
entries.summary_hk: AWS 不確定性量化庫（928★）：Conformal+貝葉斯深度學習的可擴展 UQ 框架
entries.body_en: Fortuna (awslabs/fortuna, 928★, Apache-2.0) is AWS Labs' uncertainty-quantification (UQ) library: under a unified interface it offers conformal prediction intervals, Bayesian deep learning (variational inference / deep ensembles / random projections) and calibration methods, aimed at scalable production UQ. For RIAA: an enterprise-grade tool for model uncertainty (AWS official) — engineering-grade implementation of risk measures (VaR/ES) and prediction intervals; complements [[mapie]] (sklearn ecosystem) and [[insurance-conformal]] (insurance applications); same AWS family as [[aws-fraud-graph]] and [[aws-serverless-claims-eda]].
entries.body_hk: Fortuna（awslabs/fortuna，928★，Apache-2.0）是 AWS Labs 的不確定性量化（UQ）庫：統一接口下提供 conformal 預測區間、貝葉斯深度學習（變分推斷/深度集成/隨機投影）與校準方法，面向生產環境的可擴展 UQ。對 RIAA：模型不確定性的企業級工具（AWS 官方）——風險度量（VaR/ES）與預測區間的工程化實現；與 [[mapie]]（sklearn 生態）、[[insurance-conformal]]（保險應用）互補；AWS 生態與 [[aws-fraud-graph]]、[[aws-serverless-claims-eda]] 同類。

entries.title: Puncc (DEEL)
entries.summary: Conformal 预测不确定性库（403★，DEEL/Airbus-ANITI）：回归/分类的保形方法集
entries.body: Puncc（deel-ai/puncc，403★）是 DEEL 团队（Airbus-ANITI 合作的 AI 可靠性项目）的 Python conformal 预测库：回归与分类场景的多种保形方法（split/conformalized quantile/adaptive 等），与 sklearn 接口兼容。对 RIAA：模型预测区间与可靠性的工业级实现——与 [[mapie]]、[[fortuna]] 并列的 conformal 三剑客；配 [[insurance-conformal]] 系列理解保险定价中的保形应用；DEEL 背景（航空级可靠性）对金融风控的严谨性要求有参考意义。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：DEEL conformal 预测库（回归/分类），403★
entries.summary_en: Conformal-prediction uncertainty library (403★, DEEL/Airbus-ANITI): a set of conformal methods for regression/classification
entries.summary_hk: Conformal 預測不確定性庫（403★，DEEL/Airbus-ANITI）：回歸/分類的保形方法集
entries.body_en: Puncc (deel-ai/puncc, 403★) is the DEEL team's (an AI-reliability project of Airbus-ANITI) Python conformal-prediction library: a variety of conformal methods for regression and classification (split / conformalized quantile / adaptive, etc.) with sklearn-compatible interfaces. For RIAA: industrial-grade prediction intervals and reliability — one of the conformal trio alongside [[mapie]] and [[fortuna]]; pair with the [[insurance-conformal]] series to understand conformal applications in insurance pricing; the DEEL background (aviation-grade reliability) is instructive for the rigour expected in financial risk control.
entries.body_hk: Puncc（deel-ai/puncc，403★）是 DEEL 團隊（Airbus-ANITI 合作的 AI 可靠性項目）的 Python conformal 預測庫：回歸與分類場景的多種保形方法（split/conformalized quantile/adaptive 等），與 sklearn 接口兼容。對 RIAA：模型預測區間與可靠性的工業級實現——與 [[mapie]]、[[fortuna]] 並列的 conformal 三劍客；配 [[insurance-conformal]] 系列理解保險定價中的保形應用；DEEL 背景（航空級可靠性）對金融風控的嚴謹性要求有參考意義。

entries.title: ConformalPrediction.jl
entries.summary: Julia 保形预测库（JuliaTrustworthyAI）：分类/回归的分位数保形区间
entries.body: ConformalPrediction.jl（JuliaTrustworthyAI/ConformalPrediction.jl）是 Julia 的保形预测（conformal prediction）库：为分类与回归模型提供分位数保形预测区间，与 Julia ML 生态（MLJ/Flux）集成。对 RIAA：Julia 侧的不确定性量化——与 [[mapie]]/[[fortuna]]/[[puncc]]（Python）跨语言对应；配合 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia copula）、JuliaActuary 生态使用；关联 [[insurance-conformal]]（保险应用）。
entries.verified_note: repo 页核实：Julia 保形预测库（分类/回归分位数区间）
entries.summary_en: Julia conformal-prediction library (JuliaTrustworthyAI): quantile conformal intervals for classification/regression
entries.summary_hk: Julia 保形預測庫（JuliaTrustworthyAI）：分類/回歸的分位數保形區間
entries.body_en: ConformalPrediction.jl (JuliaTrustworthyAI/ConformalPrediction.jl) is a Julia conformal-prediction library: quantile conformal prediction intervals for classification and regression models, integrated with the Julia ML ecosystem (MLJ/Flux). For RIAA: uncertainty quantification on the Julia side — the cross-language counterpart of [[mapie]]/[[fortuna]]/[[puncc]] (Python); use alongside [[copulas-jl]] (Julia copulas) and the JuliaActuary ecosystem; related: [[insurance-conformal]] (insurance applications).
entries.body_hk: ConformalPrediction.jl（JuliaTrustworthyAI/ConformalPrediction.jl）是 Julia 的保形預測（conformal prediction）庫：為分類與回歸模型提供分位數保形預測區間，與 Julia ML 生態（MLJ/Flux）集成。對 RIAA：Julia 側的不確定性量化——與 [[mapie]]/[[fortuna]]/[[puncc]]（Python）跨語言對應；配合 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia copula）、JuliaActuary 生態使用；關聯 [[insurance-conformal]]（保險應用）。

entries.title: iFraudSimulator
entries.summary: 保险欺诈网络数据合成引擎（Campo & Antonio 论文配套 R 包）：生成带欺诈网络的合成理赔数据
entries.body: iFraudSimulator（BavoDC/iFraudSimulator，1★）是 Campo & Antonio 论文《An engine to simulate insurance fraud network data》的官方配套 R 包：生成合成保险欺诈网络数据——个体保单/索赔图结构（含投保人-经纪人-机构等节点与欺诈组织关系），用于欺诈检测方法的研究与基准测试。对 RIAA：欺诈网络研究的实验数据生成器——与 [[networkfraud]]（EAJ 2024 欺诈网络分析代码，同研究线）配套；[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]（现成欺诈数据）互补；生成数据可用于 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[aws-gnn-fraud-detection]] 的 GNN 欺诈方法测试。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：Campo & Antonio 论文配套合成欺诈网络数据引擎（R 包），学术背书入池
entries.summary_en: Insurance fraud-network data synthesis engine (companion R package to Campo & Antonio): generate synthetic claims data with fraud networks
entries.summary_hk: 保險欺詐網絡數據合成引擎（Campo & Antonio 論文配套 R 包）：生成帶欺詐網絡的合成理賠數據
entries.body_en: iFraudSimulator (BavoDC/iFraudSimulator, 1★) is the official companion R package to the paper "An engine to simulate insurance fraud network data" by Campo & Antonio: it generates synthetic insurance fraud-network data — an individual policy/claim graph structure (with policyholder-broker-intermediary nodes and fraud-organisation relationships) — for research and benchmarking of fraud-detection methods. For RIAA: an experimental data generator for fraud-network research — pairs with [[networkfraud]] (the EAJ 2024 fraud-network analysis code, same research line); complements [[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]] (off-the-shelf fraud data); the generated data can be used to test GNN fraud methods from [[explainable-ai-fraud]] and [[aws-gnn-fraud-detection]].
entries.body_hk: iFraudSimulator（BavoDC/iFraudSimulator，1★）是 Campo & Antonio 論文《An engine to simulate insurance fraud network data》的官方配套 R 套件：生成合成保險欺詐網絡數據——個體保單/索賠圖結構（含投保人-經紀人-機構等節點與欺詐組織關係），用於欺詐檢測方法的研究與基準測試。對 RIAA：欺詐網絡研究的實驗數據生成器——與 [[networkfraud]]（EAJ 2024 欺詐網絡分析程式碼，同研究線）配套；[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]（現成欺詐數據）互補；生成數據可用於 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[aws-gnn-fraud-detection]] 的 GNN 欺詐方法測試。

entries.title: SmaRP (Smart Retirement Planning)
entries.summary: 瑞士养老金规划 Shiny 应用（22★，Mirai Solutions）：三支柱养老金基金演算，假设全披露
entries.body: SmaRP（miraisolutions/SmaRP，22★）是 Mirai Solutions（瑞士精算/数据科学咨询）的智能退休规划应用：基于瑞士养老金制度（三支柱体系）的 R Shiny 养老金计算器——交互式计算退休基金随时间的演变（分列各组成部分），可下载含计算方法和近似的报告；开源使底层假设与计算完全披露。对 RIAA：养老金/退休规划的可视化计算案例（瑞士三支柱 vs 香港 [[mpfa]]/[[mpfe]] 体系对照）——与 [[retirement-planning]]（概念）、[[actuarialmath]]（年金计算）配套；池中首个养老金工具，填补 pension 维度。
entries.verified_note: raw README 核实：瑞士三支柱养老金 Shiny 计算器（假设全披露），22★
entries.summary_en: Swiss pension-planning Shiny app (22★, Mirai Solutions): three-pillar retirement-fund projection with fully disclosed assumptions
entries.summary_hk: 瑞士養老金規劃 Shiny 應用（22★，Mirai Solutions）：三支柱養老金基金演算，假設全披露
entries.body_en: SmaRP (miraisolutions/SmaRP, 22★) is Mirai Solutions' (a Swiss actuarial/data-science consultancy) Smart Retirement Planning app: an R Shiny pension calculator based on the Swiss pension system (three-pillar framework) — it interactively computes and displays the evolution of retirement funds over time, split into contributing components, and can generate a downloadable report with calculation methodology and approximations; its open-source nature fully discloses the underlying assumptions. For RIAA: a visual retirement/pension-planning case study (Swiss three-pillar vs the Hong Kong [[mpfa]]/[[mpfe]] systems) — pairs with [[retirement-planning]] (the concept) and [[actuarialmath]] (annuity maths); the first pension tool in the pool, filling the pension dimension.
entries.body_hk: SmaRP（miraisolutions/SmaRP，22★）是 Mirai Solutions（瑞士精算/數據科學諮詢）的智能退休規劃應用：基於瑞士養老金制度（三支柱體系）的 R Shiny 養老金計算器——交互式計算退休基金隨時間的演變（分列各組成部分），可下載含計算方法和近似的報告；開源使底層假設與計算完全披露。對 RIAA：養老金/退休規劃的可視化計算案例（瑞士三支柱 vs 香港 [[mpfa]]/[[mpfe]] 體系對照）——與 [[retirement-planning]]（概念）、[[actuarialmath]]（年金計算）配套；池中首個養老金工具，填補 pension 維度。

For RIAA: the performance frontier of modern actuarial model engines — the engineering trade-off between recursive and vectorised/compiled approaches (an extension of the [[heavylight]] modelling framework and the [[lifelib]] ecosystem); directly instructive for understanding the compute requirements of large-scale life cash-flow simulation.

entries.title: Actuarial Add-In for Excel
entries.summary: Excel 精算插件（27★，MIT）：175 个产险函数——链梯/Mack/ODP bootstrap/暴露曲线/Panjer/copula/巨灾
entries.body: Actuarial Add-In for Excel（mdevans21/actuarial_add_in，27★，MIT，.NET）是原生 Excel 插件：把 175 个产险精算函数直接带进工作表——链梯法（chain ladder）、Mack 标准误、ODP bootstrap、MBBEFD/Swiss Re 暴露曲线、Panjer 递推、copula、巨灾建模（ELT→YLT→OEP）、17 种损失分布（含 LEV）。函数均以 ACT_ 前缀、有插入函数说明、支持 Excel 365 spill 数组；CI 全函数测试，数值与 scipy/[[chainladder]]（Python 版 [[chainladder-python]]）及已发表文献对照，ODP bootstrap 与 Peter England 的 [[stochasticreserving]] 逐位一致。对 RIAA：Excel 原生精算计算（行业日常工具）——链梯/准备金、巨灾分层（[[catmodeling]]）与 copula 的电子表格化实现，零学习成本接入现有工作流。

entries.body_en: The Actuarial Add-In for Excel (mdevans21/actuarial_add_in, 27★, MIT, .NET) is a native Excel add-in that brings 175 general-insurance actuarial functions directly to any worksheet: chain ladder, Mack standard errors, ODP bootstrap, MBBEFD / Swiss Re exposure curves, Panjer recursion, copulas, catastrophe modelling (ELT → YLT → OEP) and 17 loss distributions with LEV. Functions carry an ACT_ prefix, have Insert-Function descriptions and return spill-friendly arrays for Excel 365; the CI suite exercises every public function, reconciling deterministic results against scipy, [[chainladder]] (the Python [[chainladder-python]]) and published actuarial literature — the ODP bootstrap reconciles bit-for-bit with Peter England's [[stochasticreserving]]. For RIAA: native Excel actuarial computation (a daily industry tool) — spreadsheet-native chain ladder/reserving, catastrophe layering ([[catmodeling]]) and copulas, with zero learning curve into existing workflows.

entries.body_en: Contoso Claims (alisoliman/insurance-multi-agent, 35★) is a multi-agent insurance-claims demo built on LangGraph and Azure OpenAI (GPT-4.1): specialised agents collaborate to assess claims — a Claim Assessor agent (damage photos, repair costs, consistency), Policy Checker agent (coverage terms, eligibility), Risk Analyst agent (fraud patterns, claimant history), Communication agent (customer emails, missing-document requests) and a Supervisor agent (workflow orchestration and final recommendations) — cutting claim handling from hours to minutes. For RIAA: the LangGraph orchestration paradigm for multi-agent claims — compare the three mainstream orchestration routes: [[claims-processing-hack]] (Foundry/MCP), [[agentic-ai-hack]] (Semantic Kernel) and [[insurancea2amcp]] (A2A protocol); the fraud-detection agent parallels [[claims-fraud-guardian]].
entries.body_hk: Contoso Claims（alisoliman/insurance-multi-agent，35★）是基於 LangGraph 與 Azure OpenAI（GPT-4.1）的多智能代理理賠演示：專項代理協作評估理賠——理賠評估代理（損傷照片/維修成本/一致性）、保單核查代理（條款/資格）、風險分析代理（欺詐模式/索賠歷史）、溝通代理（客戶電郵/補件請求）、主管代理（工作流編排與綜合建議），把理賠處理從小時級縮短到分鐘級。對 RIAA：多代理理賠的 LangGraph 編排範式——與 [[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry/MCP）、[[agentic-ai-hack]]（Semantic Kernel）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（A2A 協議）對照三種主流編排路線；欺詐檢測代理與 [[claims-fraud-guardian]] 同類。

entries.title: Titanium 保险核心系统
entries.summary: 中文保险核心平台（17★，Java 21/Axon/Kafka，2026-08 活跃）：DDD+CQRS+事件驱动的多险种全生命周期微服务
entries.body: Titanium（chisss/titanium-policy 及同系列仓库，17★，Java 21/Spring Boot 4.0.1/Axon 4.10/Kafka 4.0，2026-08 活跃）是面向多险种、全生命周期与多租户场景的中文保险核心平台：DDD（领域驱动设计）+ CQRS + 事件驱动架构，微服务目录覆盖保单域（投保/承保/签发/生效/失效/终止）、理赔域、核保域、产品域、条款域、计费/保全/支付、再保险、监管、规则引擎等，配套 Vue3 管理台与共享基础库。对 RIAA：保险核心系统的架构参考（保单生命周期、领域建模、微服务治理）——与 [[digital-claims-management]]（企业级理赔系统）、[[corellia]]（Baloise 保险数据 API 规范）同属保险技术基础设施视角；事件驱动设计衔接 [[aws-serverless-claims-eda]] 的架构思路。

entries.body_en: Titanium (chisss/titanium-policy and the sibling repos, 17★, Java 21 / Spring Boot 4.0.1 / Axon 4.10 / Kafka 4.0, active 2026-08) is a Chinese insurance core platform for multi-line, full-lifecycle and multi-tenant scenarios: DDD (domain-driven design) + CQRS + event-driven architecture, with a microservice catalogue covering the policy domain (application/underwriting/issue/effective/lapse/termination), claims, underwriting, product, clause, billing/maintenance/payment, reinsurance, regulatory and rules-engine domains, plus a Vue 3 admin console and shared base libraries. For RIAA: an architecture reference for insurance core systems (policy lifecycle, domain modelling, microservice governance) — with [[digital-claims-management]] (enterprise claims system) and [[corellia]] (Baloise insurance data API spec) it forms the insurance-tech infrastructure perspective; the event-driven design connects to the architecture ideas in [[aws-serverless-claims-eda]].

entries.summary: 保险代理 CRM 平台（75★，MERN 全栈）：客户/线索/保单/续保一站式管理
entries.body: InsurancePro CRM（prolinkinfo/InsuranceProCRM，75★，MERN 全栈）是专为保险代理打造的客户关系管理平台：直观仪表盘（客户/保单/线索总览）、线索管理（线索→客户转化）、保单追踪（保单/保费/续保）、可定制工作流与品牌。对 RIAA：保险代理侧 CRM 的参考实现（前台销售管理）——与 [[titanium-insurance-core]]（保险核心系统，后台保单域）、[[digital-claims-management]]（理赔系统）构成保险技术栈的前台-核心-理赔三层视角；MERN 全栈对前端/全栈学习友好。

entries.body_en: InsurancePro CRM (prolinkinfo/InsuranceProCRM, 75★, MERN full-stack) is a customer-relationship-management platform tailored for insurance agents: an intuitive dashboard (clients/policies/leads overview), lead management (lead-to-client conversion), policy tracking (policies/premiums/renewals) and customisable workflows and branding. For RIAA: a reference implementation of agent-side CRM (front-office sales management) — with [[titanium-insurance-core]] (insurance core system, back-office policy domain) and [[digital-claims-management]] (claims system) it forms the front-office / core / claims three-layer view of the insurance tech stack; the MERN stack is friendly for front-end/full-stack learning.
